1: ===== AI_CV_Matching_Project_Plan.pdf pages=2
2: --- page 1
3: AI CV Matching Project
4: Student briefing: the project and your role
5: 1 Why this project
6: Second Talent places talent for clients through recruitment, secondment and EOR.
7: We are building an HRIS platform. One feature is AI candidate matching: a client describes a role,
8: and the system suggests the best-fit profiles.
9: 70–80% of our roles are tech (AI, front-end, back-end, full-stack), so the project focuses on tech.
10: Recruiters match CVs by hand today, which takes a lot of time. AI can shortlist faster.
11: 2 The goal
12: Give the system a job description (JD) and get back a ranked shortlist of CVs, each
13: with a short reason, that an experienced Second Talent recruiter would agree with.
14: 3 Your role
15: ① Prepare the data
16: Collect anonymised tech JDs
17: and CVs, plus about 50
18: recruiter-approved "good
19: match" pairs.
20: ② Write the matching guide
21: Explain what to extract from a
22: CV and a JD, and how much
23: each factor matters.
24: ③ Build a baseline
25: A simple matcher plus a test
26: showing how often it picks the
27: right person.
28: 4 Scope
29: ✔ In scope
30: Tech roles first
31: Anonymised Manatal JDs and CVs
32: Labelled CV–JD pairs
33: AI extraction (e.g. Claude) and a baseline
34: model
35: ✘ Out of scope (for now)
36: Any un-masked personal data
37: Building the live HRIS feature
38: Buying or scraping LinkedIn data without
39: approval
40: Sales roles
41: 5 How CV matching works, in plain words
42: 1. Read JD
43: Make a checklist
44: of what the role
45: needs
46: →
47: 2. Read CV
48: Pull out the same
49: facts about the
50: person
51: →
52: 3. Filter
53: Remove clear no-
54: gos (location,
55: notice period,
56: language)
57: →
58: 4. Score
59: Add up a weighted
60: score for each
61: factor
62: →
63: 5. Rank
64: Show the top 5
65: with a reason for
66: each
67: An AI model reads messy CV PDFs and fills in a fixed form. A machine learning model then learns
68: from labelled pairs which matches are good.
69: Second Talent · Presented by Eric Cheng (Chief of Staff) · Fri 30 Oct 2026
70: 
71: --- page 2
72: 6 What recruiters look at
73: Weight
74: Factors
75: Highest
76: Hard skills overlap (must-have vs nice-to-have) · Years of relevant experience
77: High
78: Seniority level (junior / mid / senior / lead) · Expected salary vs budget
79: Medium
80: Industry / domain background · Job stability (tenure, gaps) · Education or certificates
81: (only if the role needs them)
82: Filters
83: Location, time zone, remote eligibility · Notice period · English and other languages
84: These weights are a rough guide. We'll agree the final numbers with the recruitment team.
85: 7 Data & tools
86: Manatal (our ATS): the main source of CVs (PDF) and JDs. We also source from LinkedIn Recruiter and
87: Juicebox.
88: Starting sheet: "Manatal Examples – JD & CV (anonymised)" has 50 JDs and 100 CVs, with no
89: match labels yet.
90: Target: 100–200 tech JDs and about 50 good-match CV–JD pairs.
91: Tools: Claude for extraction and masking. Python, pandas, embeddings and Google Sheets for
92: labelling.
93: Privacy rule: mask names, emails, phones, addresses, photos and LinkedIn URLs before any data
94: leaves Second Talent. Check by hand. Nothing gets shared until Eric approves it.

218: Product Manager — WMS & Warehouse Integrations
219: Remote · full time
220: Why this role exists
221: The client is an AI-powered fulfilment and logistics ecosystem built for fast-growing e-commerce brands. From one
222: platform, merchants run global fulfilment, cross-border shipping, and AI logistics intelligence, with AI reducing
223: errors, lowering costs, and continuously optimising fulfilment and shipping as they scale globally. The ecosystem is
224: deliberately flexible: the client operates its own WMS for the warehouses it works with, and connects partner
225: warehouses and external WMS systems through the same platform.
226: Warehouse-side demand is growing fast: fulfilment accounts, white-label deals, and WMS-shaped RFPs from
227: prospects. The WMS domain now needs one dedicated owner: our own WMS, the partner WMS integrations, and
228: the Fulfillment API contract that connects any warehouse to the platform.
229: Scope of ownership
230: • All WMS product work, end to end: roadmap, PRDs, sizing with engineers, sprint delivery, QA of WMS flows.
231: • The whole WMS domain, current and future: our own WMS, partner warehouses and their WMS systems, and
232: the evaluation of new WMS partners or a next-generation in-house build.
233: • WMS delivery management day to day: integration specs, sync reliability (WMS to OMS inventory mirrors), bug
234: escalations with evidence, release coordination with the warehouse and the WMS development team.
235: • Warehouse-flavoured commercial support: WMS RFP gap analyses and feasibility answers for Sales on "can
236: the warehouse do X".
237: What the job is day to day
238: • Turn warehouse and fulfilment asks into scoped, sized cards engineers can pick up, and run them through the
239: two-week sprint cadence.
240: • Own inbound/outbound/inventory flows: receiving orders, pick-pack, dispatch, returns, carton and serial-number
241: handling, and inventory reconciliation between WMS and OMS.
242: • Manage the WMS development team hands-on: reproduce issues, bring log and database evidence rather than
243: symptoms, push for root-cause fixes over per-record patches, and keep a written record of every open issue and
244: commitment.
245: • Sit between warehouse operators, the WMS development team, merchants, and the client's engineers, and
246: keep all four aligned in writing.
247: • QA the flows yourself before they ship.
248: Requirements
249: • 3+ years product management on logistics, fulfilment, warehouse, or supply-chain software (WMS, OMS, 3PL
250: platform, or adjacent).

348: JOB DESCRIPTION
349: Job Title: FIELD SERVICE ENGINEER (FSE)
350: THE ROLE:
351: We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Field Service Engineer with hands-on experience in
352: semiconductor wafer fabrication (fab) equipment. The service engineer will be responsible for installation,
353: maintenance, troubleshooting & upgrading of semiconductor process tools to ensure maximum equipment uptime
354: & performance in customer production environment. Good communication skills, spoken & written.
355: This is a full-time position and reports directly to the Operations Director.
356: THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:
357: The ideal candidate preferably has some years of experience in wafer fab sector, either working in the fab or
358: working in a major OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) such as Applied Materials (AMAT) or Tokyo Electron
359: Limited (TEL), or in some capacity in the wafer fab production process. Our focus products & services are in the
360: Diffusion & Thin Film (TF) module/dept.
361: CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:
362: • Perform installation, qualification & acceptance of company products & services.
363: • Troubleshoot and resolve on-site technical issues
364: • Support move-in equipment hook-up phase.
365: • Document service activities, prepare technical reports & maintain accuracy.
366: • Ensure service quality and compliance with EHS, and regulatory standards
367: • Maintain clear communication with customers and internal teams
368: CRITICAL SUCCESS FACTORS/SKILLS:
369: • Willingness to learn, with a service-oriented and positive attitude.
370: • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
371: • Communication skills to articulate problem statement
372: • Knowledge of semiconductor wafer fab process
373: • Major plus if candidate has knowledge of vacuum systems, robotics, pneumatic, etc.
374: QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:
375: • Diploma or degree in either Electrical & Electronic/Mechanical/Chemical engineering, or an equivalence in
376: working related experience
377: • 2-5 years experience working in semiconductor wafer fab environment is preferred.
378: • Fresh Graduates are welcome.
379: BENEFITS & OTHERS:
380: • Group medical and dental insurance; miscellaneous allowance
381: • Annual Wage Supplement (AWS) + Variable Bonus (P&L & individual performance)
382: • OJT
383: • Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
384: ABOUT THE CLIENT
385: The client specializes in used tool sales, RF spare parts repair, and consumable part supply for the semiconductor
386: wafer fabrication industry. Its Singapore-based workshop focuses on RF generator and high-value parts repair,
387: serving key 12" wafer fabs.
388: With expertise across modules such as Diffusion, Implant, PECVD, CMP, Etch, Wet, Inspect, Metro, AMAT
389: Centura, and TEL Furnace, the client continues to expand its technical capabilities and industry footprint.
390: The client is expanding rapidly and looking for dynamic team members who want to grow in this high-tech industry.

我已读完 AI_CV_Matching_Project_Plan.pdf（以及中文对照版），并把随附的 Manatal Examples – JD & CV (anonymised).xlsx、100 份 CV 和 10 份 JD 也盘点了一遍。先说结论：

这个项目的核心在于：用约 50 组可信的人工标注，证明一个简单、可解释的匹配器能稳定把合适的人排进 Top-5，并且给出的理由站得住脚；做出“很准的模型”并不是核心目标。单页计划书要让人一眼看到四件事：数据怎么来、标签怎么打、基线怎么评、风险怎么控。

一、任务要求（从 PDF 提炼）

输入：一份 JD
输出：排好序的 Top-5 CV，每份附一句简短理由
验收：有经验的 Second Talent 招聘顾问会认可这份短名单

三项交付物：

  1. 准备数据：匿名化技术岗 JD/CV + 约 50 组招聘顾问认可的 good-match 配对
  2. 写匹配指南：从 JD/CV 分别抽什么、每个因素占多大权重
  3. 搭基线：一个简单 matcher + 一套测试，说明它多大程度能选对人

范围边界：技术岗优先；不做上线 HRIS 功能、不碰未脱敏数据、不买/爬 LinkedIn、不做销售岗。

二、现有数据盘点（这直接决定计划怎么写）

数据 实际情况 对计划的影响
JD 表 50 份，其中 Engineering 16 + Data & AI 7 = 23 份技术岗 离目标 100–200 份差 77–177 份
CV 表 100 份，其中 Engineering 30 + Data & AI 16 = 46 份技术岗 技术 CV 够做 pilot，但不够覆盖大量 JD
匹配标签 完全没有 50 组 good-match 必须自己标
JD PDF JD + Hired CV examples 里只有 10 份 JD（P01–P10） 而且多为财务、销售、市场、产品、设计等非技术岗
Hired CV 该文件夹里没有 CV，只有 JD 不能直接拿来当 50 组正样本，需要向老师/Eric 确认
CV 字段 职位、公司、技能、工作经历、教育都有，PDF 格式统一 抽取难度低，适合做结构化 baseline
缺失字段 很多 CV 没有期望薪资、notice period、语言、地点 评分时这些应记为 unknown（中性），不能当 0 分

最重要的发现：现有数据只能支撑一个 23 个技术 JD 的 pilot，而 brief 写的是 100–200 个 JD。单页计划书里必须明确写“数据补充计划”或“本期 scope 缩小到现有 23 个 JD + 扩展方案”，不要假装差距不存在。

三、实施路线：6 个工作包

WP0 项目启动与口径确认（第 1 周初）

  • 和老师/Eric 确认四件事：
    • “good match” 的 operational 定义：是“值得进 shortlist”，还是“完美匹配”？
    • 本期是用现有 23 个技术 JD，还是要从 Manatal 补到 100+？
    • 是否允许调用 Claude API？数据脱敏到什么程度？
    • 最终验收指标（Top-5 hit rate？招聘顾问盲评一致率？）
  • 先锁定 2–3 个技术岗位族，例如 AI/ML、Backend、Full-stack，不要一上来铺 8 个族。
  • 产出：1 页 scope + 成功指标。

WP1 数据工程与隐私（第 1 周）

  • 建 jd_id / cv_id 主表，把 xlsx 和 PDF 统一解析成 JSONL。
  • 清洗：去重、统一地点（KL / Kuala Lumpur）、统一职位名、建技能词典（Python、Go、React、Kubernetes…）、计算相关年限。
  • 脱敏复核：姓名、邮箱、电话、地址、照片、LinkedIn URL；只把脱敏副本送外部 API；人工抽查 20 份；Eric 批准后才外传。
  • 产出：jds.jsonl、cvs.jsonl、data_dictionary.md、masking checklist。

WP2 写匹配指南（第 1–2 周）

定义两套 schema：

JD 抽取字段：must-have skills、nice-to-have、min years、seniority、location/remote、salary budget、languages、notice period、education、domain。

CV 抽取字段：skills + 证据、每项技能年限、总相关年限、seniority、location、expected salary、notice、languages、education、tenure/gaps。

权重直接映射 brief 的四档：

档位 因素 建议分值
Highest 硬技能重合（must/nice）、相关年限 35 + 20 = 55
High 资历层级、期望薪资 vs 预算 15 + 10 = 25
Medium 行业/领域、稳定性、学历/证书 10 + 5 + 5 = 20
Filters 地点/时区/远程、notice、语言 pass/fail 门槛

标注用 0–3 分 rubric：

  • 3 = 强烈推荐面试
  • 2 = 可以进 shortlist
  • 1 = 边缘，可看可不看
  • 0 = 不合适

产出：2–3 页 matching guide + 一页标注手册（含正例/负例示例）。

WP3 标注约 50 组配对（第 2 周）

  • 采样方式很重要：12–15 个技术 JD × 4–5 份 CV = 50–75 对。
  • 每个 JD 至少包含：1 个强正例、1 个边缘例、2 个明显负例（hard negatives：技能差一点、seniority 过高/过低、地点或薪资不符、非技术背景）。
  • 不要随机抽 CV，否则几乎全是负例，模型学不到边界。
  • 前 20 对由两人独立标注，算 Cohen's kappa；分歧讨论后定稿。
  • 每条标签必须写理由，并引用 CV 里的证据（技能、年限、公司、项目）。
  • 产出：gold_pairs.csv（jd_id, cv_id, label, reason, annotator）。

WP4 搭基线模型（第 2–3 周）

按“先跑通、再增强”的顺序：

  • v0：硬过滤 + 关键词重合，先跑通流程。
  • v1（主基线）：技能词典 + BM25/TF-IDF + 加权评分。
  • v2：embedding 语义相似度（sentence-transformers 或多语言 embedding），hybrid 分数。
  • v3（可选）：Logistic Regression / LightGBM 学习排序。50 组样本太少，只能做 ablation，不能当主模型。

评分公式建议：

score = 0.35 * 技能重合
      + 0.20 * 相关年限
      + 0.15 * 资历层级
      + 0.10 * 薪资匹配
      + 0.10 * 行业/领域
      + 0.05 * 稳定性
      + 0.05 * 学历/证书

缺失字段记 0.5（中性），不要记 0，否则会系统性惩罚匿名化简历。

理由生成：模板优先，例如“匹配 5/6 项必备技能；6 年 Python；缺 Kubernetes；地点匹配”。LLM 只负责润色，禁止无证据陈述。

产出：match.py，接口 rank(jd_id) -> top5 + reasons。

WP5 评估（第 3 周）

  • 主指标：Top-5 hit rate（Top-5 里是否至少有一个 good match）、nDCG@5。
  • 次指标：Precision@5、MRR、filter precision。
  • 切分：按 JD 做 leave-one-JD-out 或 5-fold group split，不要随机按 pair 切，否则同一 JD 会泄漏。
  • 对照：random、keyword-only、embedding-only。
  • 人工评估：3 位 reviewer 盲评 5 个 JD 的 Top-5，1–5 分，报告一致率。
  • 抽取质量：人工核对 20 份文档，报告 skill F1、years MAE、seniority accuracy。
  • 建议目标（和老师确认后再写死）：
    • Top-5 hit rate ≥ 70%
    • nDCG@5 ≥ 0.75
    • 比 keyword baseline 相对提升 ≥ 15%
    • 抽取 F1 ≥ 0.85
    • 招聘顾问盲评一致率 ≥ 80%
  • 产出：evaluation report + error taxonomy（解析错误、漏 must-have、seniority 错、地点/薪资错、理由幻觉）。

WP6 交付与答辩（第 4 周）

  • 代码 repo + README + demo notebook。
  • 5–8 页报告。
  • 10 分钟 demo：现场选 1 个 JD，展示 Top-5 和理由。
  • 单页 plan PDF。
  • 备用方案：如果 JD 数量不够，展示“23 个 JD pilot + 扩展到 100+ 的具体计划”。

四、四周排期与分工

周 主要任务 里程碑
Week 1 kickoff、数据索引、脱敏复核、schema、guide v1、标 10 对 数据可用 + guide 定稿
Week 2 标完 50 对 + kappa、v0/v1、评估脚本 主基线可跑
Week 3 v2、完整评估、error analysis、理由生成、盲评 指标和错误分析出来
Week 4 报告、demo、单页 PDF、buffer 全部交付

4–5 人分工建议：

  • A 数据/隐私：解析、清洗、脱敏、数据字典
  • B 标注/指南：matching guide、标注手册、标签 QA
  • C 建模：v0/v1/v2、评分与理由
  • D 评估：指标、切分、盲评、错误分析
  • E 项目/写作：排期、单页计划书、报告、demo（可由 A–D 兼任）

五、单页 PDF 计划书建议结构

一页 A4，建议 3 栏或上下结构，正文控制在 800–1000 中文字（英文约 500–600 词），字号 9–10pt，配一张 5 步流程图：

  1. 标题 + 团队/日期/客户
  2. 问题与目标（2–3 行）：招聘顾问人工筛简历慢；目标 JD → Top-5 + 理由
  3. 范围与数据（3 行）：50 JD / 100 CV，其中 23 个技术 JD；50 组标签；明确 out of scope
  4. 方法（核心区域）：5 步流程图 + 权重表（Highest/High/Medium/Filters）
  5. 评估与成功标准：Top-5 hit rate、nDCG@5、抽取 F1、盲评一致率
  6. 4 周时间线：用 4 个横条或里程碑
  7. 风险与应对：隐私、标签少、JD 数量不足、字段缺失
  8. 交付物：数据包、guide、baseline repo、评估报告、demo

单页计划书不要写成“技术方案书”，老师更想看到：目标可衡量、数据有来源、标签有方法、风险有预案、四周能做完。

六、最容易被问倒的点

  1. 23 个技术 JD vs 目标 100–200：必须写明补充计划或缩小 scope，不能回避。
  2. 50 组样本太少，不能训练复杂模型：定位为“评估集 + 规则/embedding 基线”，ML 只做 ablation。
  3. 标签主观：双人标注 + rubric + 分歧仲裁，报告 kappa。
  4. 匿名 CV 缺薪资/notice：unknown 按中性处理，不惩罚。
  5. LLM 抽取幻觉：固定 schema + 证据 span + 20 份人工核对。
  6. 数据泄漏：按 JD 切分，不按 pair 随机切。
  7. 隐私合规：脱敏副本 + 人工复核 + Eric 批准，才允许离开 Second Talent。
  8. “招聘顾问会认可”太虚：把它变成可测指标（Top-5 hit rate + 盲评一致率）。

如果你愿意，我可以直接帮你做下一步，三选一：

  1. 起草这份单页 PDF 计划书（中英文版，按上面的结构排版）

  3. 起草 matching guide + 标注表模板（含权重、0–3 rubric、正负例）

<div class=\"eyebrow\">STAT6207 · 期末小组项目 · 单页计划书</div>\n    <h1>AI 简历匹配项目</h1>\n    <div class=\"sub\">从 JD 到 Top-5 候选人短名单：一个可解释、可评估的匹配基线<br>让资深招聘顾问愿意直接用的第一版筛选工具</div>\n    <div class=\"meta\">\n      <b>Second Talent</b>\n      学生项目简报 · 2026.11.04<br>\n      v1.0 · 单页计划书<br>\n      <span class=\"tag\">汇报对象：Eric Cheng · Chief of Staff</span>\n    </div>\n  </header>\n\n  <!-- KPI -->\n  <div class=\"kpis\">\n    <div class=\"kpi\"><b>50</b><span>组人工标注的<br>good-match 配对</span></div>\n    <div class=\"kpi\"><b>23</b><span>个现有技术 JD<br>（pilot 范围）</span></div>\n    <div class=\"kpi\"><b>≥70<em>%</em></b><span>Top-5 命中率<br>目标值</span></div>\n    <div class=\"kpi\"><b>4</b><span>周完成<br>从启动到交付</span></div>\n  </div>\n\n  <!-- MAIN -->\n  <main class=\"main\">\n\n    <!-- LEFT COLUMN -->\n    <div class=\"col\">\n\n      <section>\n        <div class=\"sec-head\">\n          <div class=\"sec-num\">01</div>\n          <div class=\"sec-title\">问题与目标<small>WHY &amp; WHAT</small></div>\n        </div>\n        <p>Second Talent 约 <strong>70–80%</strong> 的岗位是技术岗，招聘顾问目前逐份人工比对简历，耗时且标准不一致。本项目为技术岗建立一条可复现的匹配基线：<strong>输入一份 JD，输出 Top-5 简历与逐条理由</strong>，并用招聘顾问认可的配对验证它是否真的“选对人”。</p>\n        <div class=\"goal\">\n          <div class=\"lead\"><strong>目标不是做上线功能，而是证明：</strong>一个简单、可解释的匹配器，能够达到资深招聘顾问的短名单标准。</div>\n          <div class=\"chips\">\n            <span class=\"chip\">Top-5 命中率 <b>≥ 70%</b></span>\n            <span class=\"chip\">nDCG@5 <b>≥ 0.75</b></span>\n            <span class=\"chip\">盲评一致率 <b>≥ 80%</b></span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      <section>\n        <div class=\"sec-head\">\n          <div class=\"sec-num\">02</div>\n          <div class=\"sec-title\">方法与权重<small>HOW IT WORKS</small></div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"pipeline\">\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">1</div><div class=\"k\">读 JD</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">把岗位要求整理成 <b>must-have / nice-to-have</b> 清单</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">2</div><div class=\"k\">读 CV</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">抽取同一组字段：技能、年限、资历、地点、薪资</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">3</div><div class=\"k\">过滤</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">地点 / 时区 / 语言 / notice period 作为硬门槛</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">4</div><div class=\"k\">打分</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">按权重加总；缺失字段按 <b>中性 0.5</b> 计，不惩罚匿名简历</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">5</div><div class=\"k\">排序</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">输出 Top-5，每个人附一句<b>可核验的证据理由</b></div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <table class=\"weights\">\n          <thead>\n            <tr><th style=\"width:17%;\">权重档</th><th style=\"width:11%;\">分值</th><th>因素</th></tr>\n          </thead>\n          <tbody>\n            <tr>\n              <td><span class=\"tier t-highest\">Highest</span></td>\n              <td class=\"w-num\">55</td>\n              <td class=\"w-factors\">硬技能重合 <b>35</b> · 相关经验年限 <b>20</b></td>\n            </tr>\n            <tr>\n              <td><span class=\"tier t-high\">High</span></td>\n              <td class=\"w-num\">25</td>\n              <td class=\"w-factors\">资历层级 <b>15</b> · 期望薪资 vs 预算 <b>10</b></td>\n            </tr>\n            <tr>\n              <td><span class=\"tier t-medium\">Medium</span></td>\n              <td class=\"w-num\">20</td>\n              <td class=\"w-factors\">行业/领域 <b>10</b> · 稳定性 <b>5</b> · 学历/证书 <b>5</b></td>\n            </tr>\n            <tr>\n              <td><span class=\"tier t-filter\">Filters</span></td>\n              <td class=\"w-num\">门槛</td>\n              <td class=\"w-factors\">地点 / 远程 · notice period · 语言 → <b>pass / fail</b></td>\n            </tr>\n          </tbody>\n        </table>\n        <div class=\"note\"><b>技术路线：</b>v0 关键词 → v1 BM25 + 技能词典 → v2 embedding hybrid。50 组样本不训练复杂模型，ML 只做 ablation；<b>权重在第 1 周与招聘团队确认后冻结。</b></div>\n\n        <div class=\"example\">\n          <div class=\"cap\">输出示例 · <em>JD: Senior Backend Engineer</em>（示意）</div>\n          <div class=\"rank\">\n            <div class=\"r\">1</div><div class=\"id\">CV-018 · 92</div>\n            <div class=\"why\">6/6 必备技能；7 年 Go/Python；缺 Kubernetes；地点与薪资匹配</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"rank\">\n            <div class=\"r r2\">2</div><div class=\"id\">CV-027 · 84</div>\n            <div class=\"why\">5/6 必备技能；5 年 Python；有微服务经验；薪资待确认</div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      <section>\n        <div class=\"sec-head\">\n          <div class=\"sec-num\">03</div>\n          <div class=\"sec-title\">评估方案<small>HOW WE PROVE IT</small></div>\n        </div>\n        <ul class=\"eval-list\">\n          <li><b>Gold set：</b>12–15 个技术 JD × 4–5 份 CV ≈ 50–75 对；0–3 rubric（3=强烈推荐，2=可进短名单，1=边缘，0=不合适）。</li>\n          <li><b>标注可靠性：</b>前 20 对由两人独立标注，报告 Cohen's kappa；分歧仲裁后定稿，每条标签必须引用 CV 证据。</li>\n          <li><b>评估协议：</b>按 JD 做 leave-one-JD-out，避免同一岗位泄漏；对照 random、keyword、embedding 三个基线。</li>\n          <li><b>指标：</b>主指标 Top-5 hit rate、nDCG@5；辅以 P@5、MRR、抽取 F1、理由可核验率；错误按解析 / 漏 must-have / 资历 / 地点薪资 / 理由幻觉分类。</li>\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n\n    </div>\n\n    <!-- RIGHT COLUMN -->\n    <div class=\"col\">\n\n      <section>\n        <div class=\"sec-head\">\n          <div class=\"sec-num\">04</div>\n          <div class=\"sec-title\">数据与范围<small>DATA &amp; SCOPE</small></div>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"card\">\n          <table class=\"data-table\">\n            <tr><td>JD 总量</td><td><b>50</b> 份，其中技术岗 <b>23</b> 份</td></tr>\n            <tr><td>CV 总量</td><td><b>100</b> 份，其中技术岗 <b>46</b> 份</td></tr>\n class=\"gap\"><b>关键缺口：</b>brief 目标 100–200 个技术 JD，现有仅 23 个。本期先以 23 个 JD 做 pilot，并申请补充 30–50 个；若无法补充，在报告中明确 scope 与扩展方案，不把差距留到答辩。</div>\n          <div class=\"scope\">\n            <div class=\"box in\"><b>✔ 纳入</b>技术岗（AI/ML、Backend、Full-stack）· 匿名 JD/CV · 50 组标注 · Claude 抽取 + 基线</div>\n            <div class=\"box out\"><b>✘ 不纳入</b>未脱敏数据 · 上线 HRIS · 买/爬 LinkedIn · 销售岗</div>\n          </div>\n   "content": "import io\n\nsrc = io.open('plan_source/one_page_plan_cn.html', encoding='utf-8').read()\nhead = src[:src.index('<body>') + len('<body>')]\nhead = head.replace('<html lang=\"zh-CN\">', '<html lang=\"en\">')\nhead = head.replace('<title>AI 简历匹配项目 · 单页计划书</title>',\n                    '<title>AI CV Matching Project · One-Page Plan</title>')\nhead = head.replace('font-family:\"Microsoft YaHei\",\"PingFang SC\",\"Noto Sans SC\",sans-serif;',\n                    'font-family:\"Segoe UI\",\"Helvetica Neue\",Arial,sans-serif;')\n\nbody = r'''\n<div class=\"page\">\n\n  <!-- HERO -->\n  <header class=\"hero\">\n    <div class=\"grid-lines\"></div>\n    <div class=\"eyebrow\">STAT6207 · FINAL GROUP PROJECT · ONE-PAGE PLAN</div>\n    <h1>AI CV Matching Project</h1>\n    <div class=\"sub\">From a JD to a Top-5 shortlist: an explainable, evaluable matching baseline<br>A first-pass screening tool a senior recruiter would actually use</div>\n    <div class=\"meta\">\n      <b>Second Talent</b>\n      Student project briefing · 04 Nov 2026<br>\n      v1.0 · One-page plan<br>\n      <span class=\"tag\">Prepared for Eric Cheng · Chief of Staff</span>\n    </div>\n  </header>\n\n  <!-- KPI -->\n  <div class=\"kpis\">\n    <div class=\"kpi\"><b>50</b><span>recruiter-approved<br>good-match pairs</span></div>\n    <div class=\"kpi\"><b>23</b><span>existing tech JDs<br>(pilot scope)</span></div>\n    <div class=\"kpi\"><b>≥70<em>%</em></b><span>target Top-5<br>hit rate</span></div>\n    <div class=\"kpi\"><b>4</b><span>weeks from kick-off<br>to delivery</span></div>\n  </div>\n\n  <!-- MAIN -->\n  <main class=\"main\">\n\n    <!-- LEFT COLUMN -->\n    <div class=\"col\">\n\n      <section>\n        <div class=\"sec-head\">\n          <div class=\"sec-num\">01</div>\n          <div class=\"sec-title\">Problem &amp; objective<small>WHY &amp; WHAT</small></div>\n        </div>\n        <p>Second Talent fills <strong>70–80%</strong> of its roles in tech. Recruiters still match CVs by hand — slow, and inconsistent across reviewers. We will build a reproducible matching baseline for tech roles: <strong>given one JD, return the <span class=\"nw\">Top-5</span> CVs with a short, evidence-based reason for each</strong>, then test it against pairs a recruiter has approved.</p>\n        <div class=\"goal\">\n          <div class=\"lead\"><strong>Not a production feature.</strong> The goal is to prove that a simple, explainable matcher can meet a senior recruiter's shortlist bar.</div>\n          <div class=\"chips\">\n            <span class=\"chip\">Top-5 hit rate <b>≥ 70%</b></span>\n            <span class=\"chip\">nDCG@5 <b>≥ 0.75</b></span>\n            <span class=\"chip\">Blind-review agreement <b>≥ 80%</b></span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      <section>\n        <div class=\"sec-head\">\n          <div class=\"sec-num\">02</div>\n          <div class=\"sec-title\">Method &amp; weights<small>HOW IT WORKS</small></div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"pipeline\">\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">1</div><div class=\"k\">Read JD</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">Turn the role into a <b>must-have / nice-to-have</b> checklist</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">2</div><div class=\"k\">Read CV</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">Extract the same fields: skills, years, seniority, location, salary</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">3</div><div class=\"k\">Filter</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">Location / time zone / language / notice period as hard gates</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">4</div><div class=\"k\">Score</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">Weighted sum; missing fields count as <b>neutral 0.5</b>, not zero</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"step\">\n            <div class=\"n\">5</div><div class=\"k\">Rank</div>\n            <div class=\"d\">Top-5, each with a <b>verifiable, evidence-based reason</b></div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <table class=\"weights\">\n          <thead>\n            <tr><th style=\"width:17%;\">Tier</th><th style=\"width:11%;\">Pts</th><th>Factors</th></tr>\n          </thead>\n          <tbody>\n            <tr>\n              <td><span class=\"tier t-highest\">Highest</span></td>\n              <td class=\"w-num\">55</td>\n              <td class=\"w-factors\">Hard-skill overlap <b>35</b> · Relevant years <b>20</b></td>\n            </tr>\n            <tr>\n              <td><span class=\"tier t-high\">High</span></td>\n              <td class=\"w-num\">25</td>\n              <td class=\"w-factors\">Seniority <b>15</b> · Salary vs budget <b>10</b></td>\n            </tr>\n            <tr>\n              <td><span class=\"tier t-medium\">Medium</span></td>\n              <td class=\"w-num\">20</td>\n              <td class=\"w-factors\">Domain <b>10</b> · Stability <b>5</b> · Education / certs <b>5</b></td>\n            </tr>\n            <tr>\n              <td><span class=\"tier t-filter\">Filters</span></td>\n              <td class=\"w-num\">Gate</td>\n              <td class=\"w-factors\">Location / remote · notice period · language → <b>pass / fail</b></td>\n            </tr>\n          </tbody>\n        </table>\n        <div class=\"note\"><b>Tech route:</b> v0 keywords → v1 BM25 + skill dictionary → v2 embedding hybrid. With only 50 pairs we will not train a complex model; ML is an ablation only. <b>Weights and targets are frozen after Week 1 sign-off.</b></div>\n\n        <div class=\"example\">\n          <div class=\"cap\">Output example · <em>JD: Senior Backend Engineer</em> (illustrative)</div>\n          <div class=\"rank\">\n            <div class=\"r\">1</div><div class=\"id\">CV-018 · 92</div>\n            <div class=\"why\">6/6 must-have skills; 7 yrs Go/Python; missing Kubernetes; location &amp; salary fit</div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"rank\">\n            <div class=\"r r2\">2</div><div class=\"id\">CV-027 · 84</div>\n            <div class=\"why\">5/6 must-have skills; 5 yrs Python; microservices experience; salary to confirm</div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      <section>\n        <div class=\"sec-head\">\n          <div class=\"sec-num\">03</div>\n          <div class=\"sec-title\">Evaluation<small>HOW WE PROVE IT</small></div>\n        </div>\n        <ul class=\"eval-list\">\n          <li><b>Gold set:</b> 12–15 tech JDs × 4–5 CVs ≈ 50–75 pairs; 0–3 rubric (3 = strong yes, 2 = shortlist, 1 = borderline, 0 = no).</li>\n          <li><b>Reliability:</b> first 20 pairs double-annotated; report Cohen's kappa; adjudicate disagreements; every label cites CV evidence.</li>\n          <li><b>Protocol:</b> leave-one-JD-out to avoid leakage; compare against random, keyword, and embedding baselines.</li>\n          <li><b>Metrics:</b> primary Top-5 hit rate and nDCG@5; secondary P@5, MRR, extraction F1, reason verifiability; error taxonomy: parsing / missed must-have / seniority / location-salary / hallucinated reason.</li>\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n\n    </div>\n\n    <!-- RIGHT COLUMN -->\n    <div class=\"col\">\n\n      <section>\n        <div class=\"sec-head\">\n          <div class=\"sec-num\">04</div>\n          <div class=\"sec-title\">Data &amp; scope<small>DATA &amp; SCOPE</small></div>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"card\">\n          <table class=\"data-table\">\n            <tr><td>JD total</td><td><b>50</b>, of which <b>23</b> tech</td></tr>\n            <tr><td>CV total</td><td><b>100</b>, of which <b>46</b> tech</td></tr>\n            <tr><td>Match labels</td><td><b>0</b> now → <b>50</b> this term</td></tr>\n            <tr><td>Hired examples</td><td><b>10</b> PDFs, JDs only, mostly non-tech</td></tr>\n          </table>\n          <div class=\"gap\"><b>Key gap:</b> the brief targets 100–200 tech JDs; we have 23.   1. 问题与目标：从 JD 到 Top-5 + 逐条理由，并给出可量化指标
  2. 方法与权重：5 步流程 + Highest / High / Medium / Filters 四档权重
  3. 评估方案：50 组正例 + 50 组 hard negatives、0–3 rubric、双人标注与 kappa、按 JD 切分
  4. 数据与范围：如实写出 23 个技术 JD 与 100–200 目标的缺口，并给出 pilot + 补充方案
  5. 四周排期：W1 数据与指南 → W2 标注与基线 → W3 增强与评估 → W4 交付
  6. 风险与应对：JD 不足、样本少、字段缺失、标签主观、隐私合规
  7. 交付物：数据包、Matching Guide、Python repo、评估报告、答辩 demo

有两点建议你提交前确认：

1. xlsx 里我用了什么

Manatal Examples – JD & CV (anonymised).xlsx 我在写计划书前已经读过：

  • JD Examples：50 份 JD，其中 Engineering 16 + Data & AI 7 = 23 份技术岗
  • CV Examples：100 份 CV，其中 Engineering 30 + Data & AI 16 = 46 份技术岗

这些数字都进了计划书的 KPI、数据表和 scope 部分，数据表里也直接写了这个文件名。

2. 我之前漏掉、现在已修正的一点

JD + Hired CV examples 里的 10 份 PDF，我最初只读了第 1 页，看到是 JD，就在计划书里写成了“仅含 JD”。实际上每份 PDF 后面都有：

CV OF THE HIRED CANDIDATE

也就是说，这 10 份 PDF 是 10 组 JD + hired CV 的招聘顾问认可正例，不是 0 组标签。这个对计划影响很大，已经改到两个版本里：

  • 数据表新增：10 份 PDF = 10 组 JD + hired CV 正例
  • 匹配标签：已有 10 组正例 → 目标 50 正例 + 50 负例
  • Gold set：10 组 hired 正例（校准）+ 40 组技术岗正例 + 50 组 hard negatives ≈ 100 对
  • W1：复核 10 组 hired 正例，校准 rubric
  • W2：补标 40 组技术正例 + 50 组负例

3. 已重新导出并检查

  • AI_CV_Matching_OnePage_Plan_EN.pdf（1 页，已更新）

现在计划书按 “10 组 hired 正例（校准）+ 40 组技术正例”= 50 组正例 来写。另一种更严格的做法是：

  • 10 组 hired 只做校准，不计入技术岗指标
  • 另外标 50 组纯技术岗正例 + 50 组负例（总量约 110 对）

明白了，这个区分很关键。最新版计划书已经按你说的三层数据结构重写，并且两个 PDF 都重新导出、确认仍是 A4 单页。

现在计划书里怎么用这三部分数据

1. Anonymised-CVs-100 = 100 份原始 CV PDF

作为原始证据来源：抽取技能、年限、项目经历时以 PDF 为准，理由也要能引用 PDF 里的证据。

2. Manatal Examples – JD & CV (anonymised).xlsx = 50 JD + 100 条结构化 CV 摘要

  • 这 100 条摘要与 100 份 PDF 按 Ref（CV-001…CV-100）一一对应
  • 表里没有匹配标签
  • 计划书把它当作 structured index / silver label：用摘要做初始字段和索引，再用 LLM 在 PDF 上补证据、补缺失字段，并与摘要交叉核对，而不是把 xlsx 和 PDF 当成两套独立数据

3. JD + Hired CV examples = 10 组“完美匹配”范例

  • 每份 PDF = 1 份 JD + 1 份 hired CV
  • 计划书把这 10 组作为 known-good 测试集：给定 hired JD，看系统能不能把实际被雇佣的 CV 排进 Top-1 / Top-5
  • 它们不参与调参，避免“自己考自己”

计划书具体改了什么

  • 数据表：
    • 起始表：50 JD / 100 CV 摘要（技术 23 / 46）
    • Hired 范例：10 组 JD + hired CV 完美匹配
    • 匹配标签：10 组 known-good → 目标 50 正例 + 50 负例
    • 数据文件：Manatal…xlsx + 100 份 CV PDF
  • 评估：
    • 10 组 known-good 做 Top-1 / Top-5 检索测试
    • 另标 50 组技术岗正例 + 50 组 hard negatives，用于 Top-5 hit rate、nDCG@5 等主指标
  • 排期：
    • W1：按 Ref 对齐 100 份 PDF，复核 10 组 hired
    • W2：标 50 技术正例 + 50 负例 + kappa

文件

  • AI_CV_Matching_OnePage_Plan_CN.pdf（已更新，预览窗口打开的就是这版）
  • AI_CV_Matching_OnePage_Plan_EN.pdf
  • 源文件：plan_source/one_page_plan_cn.html、plan_source/one_page_plan_en.html
  • 数据口径说明：plan_source/README.md

一个方法上的提醒：10 组 known-good 样本量很小，适合做 sanity check / 回归测试，不适合单独支撑统计结论；主评估仍然是 50+50 的 gold set。测试时把 10 份 hired CV 加入候选池、单独报告结果，不混进标注集。

如果时间紧，50 正例 + 50 负例的工作量偏大，可以降到 40+40，但指标置信度会低一些。你希望保持现在的 50+50，还是改成更稳妥的 40+40？

可以，这个任务我能做。我先检查了环境，下面是我的完整开展方案。我先不创建/复制任何文件，等你确认几个关键点后再在 HW4_6207 开工。

0. 环境检查结果

  • GPU：RTX 5080 Laptop，16GB 显存
  • LM Studio 已安装，已有 3 个本地模型：
    • qwen2.5-coder-14b-instruct（14B，Qwen2）
    • deepseek/deepseek-r1-0528-qwen3-8b（8B，Qwen3）
    • text-embedding-nomic-embed-text-v1.5（embedding）
  • LM Studio 显示 Server ON，但 localhost:1234 暂时拒绝连接；我会先重载模型/重启 server 再批量跑
  • Python 已有 torch（CPU 版）、sklearn、pandas、pymupdf、openpyxl、reportlab；缺 sentence-transformers、faiss
  • AE 数据量很小（约 150 份文档），CPU 足够；LLM 走 LM Studio 的 GPU，不依赖 CUDA 版 PyTorch
  • HW4_6207 目录已存在但目前是空的

1. 最关键的前提：Ground Truth 从哪里来

这是开始前必须确认的。现有数据里：

  • Anonymised-CVs-100：100 份 CV PDF，没有 JD 匹配标签
  • Manatal Examples...xlsx：50 份 JD + 100 条 CV 摘要，没有匹配标签
  • JD + Hired CV examples：10 组 JD + hired CV，是唯一带“完美匹配”标签的数据

我核对过：这 10 份 hired CV 基本不在那 100 份 CV 里（例如 P01 的 Cardia、P04 的 BP 都没有出现在 xlsx 的 100 条记录中）。所以：

如果 Ground Truth 用这 10 组，候选池必须是 100 份 CV + 10 份 hired CV = 110 份；否则正确 CV 根本不在池子里，Recall 必然是 0。

我的建议是：

  • 把这 10 组只用于评估，不参与关键词提取、不参与 AE 训练
  • 每组 JD 对应 1 份相关 CV，计算 Recall@10 / Recall@5 / MRR
  • 你说的“先不管这个文件夹”，如果是指“不作为输入数据”，那和这个方案兼容；如果你希望连评估也不用它，就需要你另外提供一份 Ground Truth 标签文件，否则 Recall 无法计算

这一点需要你确认。

2. 工作目录设计

所有产出都放在：

HW4_6207/
├─ data/
│  ├─ raw/                 # 复制进来的 100 份 CV PDF + xlsx
│  ├─ processed/           # cv_text.jsonl, jd_text.jsonl
│  └─ ground_truth/        # 10 组 GT 的 jd_id/cv_id（如确认使用）
├─ src/
│  ├─ parse_data.py
│  ├─ extract_keywords.py
│  ├─ cluster_keywords.py
│  ├─ train_ae.py
│  ├─ retrieve.py
│  ├─ evaluate.py
│  └─ error_analysis.py
├─ outputs/
│  ├─ keywords/            # cv_keywords.jsonl, jd_keywords.jsonl
│  ├─ clusters/            # keyword_clusters.json, vocab.json
│  ├─ models/              # ae_model.pt, scaler.pkl
│  ├─ retrieval/           # rankings.csv
│  └─ metrics/             # metrics.json, per_query.csv
├─ report/
│  ├─ report_cn_en.html
│  ├─ figures/
│  └─ HW4_Report_CN_EN.pdf
├─ README.md
└─ requirements.txt

3. 技术路线（对应作业 1–7）

Step 1：本地 LLM 关键词提取

  • 数据：
    • CV：Anonymised-CVs-100\Anonymised CVs 下 100 份 PDF
    • JD：xlsx 的 JD Examples 表，Job description 列，共 50 份
    • 不把 JD + Hired CV examples 作为提取输入
  • 调用方式：LM Studio 的 OpenAI-compatible API，本地模型，temperature=0
  • 先在同一批 5 份文档上对比：
    • qwen2.5-coder-14b-instruct
    • deepseek-r1-0528-qwen3-8b
  • 选 JSON 合规率、关键词质量更好的做主力；都不理想再下载 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
  • 输出 schema：
    • JD：must_have_skills、nice_to_have_skills、tools、domains、seniority、min_years、languages、location、certifications
    • CV：skills、tools、domains、roles、years、seniority、education、certifications、languages、location
    • 每个关键词带 term、category、importance（1–3）、evidence
  • 所有结果缓存为 JSONL，按文档 hash 去重，失败自动重试
  • 质量检查：人工抽查 10 份；JSON 合法率；CV 关键词与 xlsx Skills 列交叉核对

Step 2：合并/聚类相似关键词

  • 归一化：小写、去标点、单复数、缩写（JS→JavaScript、ML→Machine Learning 等）
  • 用本地 nomic-embed-text 对关键词做 embedding
  • 用 cosine + 层次聚类/社区发现合并同义词
  • 每个 cluster 选一个 canonical term（最高频或 LLM 决定）
  • 输出：
    • keyword_clusters.json
    • vocab.json
    • 文档–关键词矩阵（TF-IDF 或 binary）
  • 人工检查 top 50 clusters，避免把“Java”和“JavaScript”这类错误合并

Step 3：构建 Autoencoder（AE）

  • 输入：文档–关键词矩阵（约 150 份文档 × 词表维度）
  • 结构：V → 512 → 128 → bottleneck 32/64 → 128 → 512 → V
  • GELU + Dropout + BatchNorm；可选 denoising（随机 mask 15% 关键词）
  • 损失：MSE / BCE；AdamW；early stopping
  • 输出：
    • ae_model.pt
    • 所有 CV/JD 的 32/64 维向量 doc_vectors.npz
  • 对比基线：
    • 原始 TF-IDF cosine
    • BM25（如可用）
    • 关键词重叠率
    • Nomic embedding cosine
  • AE 只做无监督编码，不使用 Ground Truth 标签

Step 4：Top-10 检索

  • 对 Ground Truth 中每个 JD：
    • 用 AE 编码 JD

  • 不使用 Excel（50 JD / 100 条 CV 摘要都不参与）

一、训练与评估口径（这是关键）

你说得对：如果 10 组 GT 只用于评估，模型没有监督信号。所以我会这样做：

  1. 无监督预训练 AE：用 110 份 CV + 10 份 JD 的关键词向量做重构训练，让 AE 学会文档表示
  2. 监督匹配微调：在 AE bottleneck 后加一个 retrieval head，用 10 组 GT 做 contrastive / listwise loss——每个 JD 的 positive 是它的 hired CV，其余 109 份 CV 作为 negatives
  3. 主评估：leave-one-pair-out（10 折）
    • 每折留出 1 组 GT（JD + hired CV）
    • 用其余 9 组 + 100 份匿名 CV 训练
    • 用留出的 JD 在 110 份 CV 中检索 Top-10
    • 10 折平均，得到可信的 Recall
    • 这样每一组 GT 都进入过训练（9 次），同时评估是 held-out
  4. 辅助：in-sample 上界
    • 用全部 10 组训练，再在同一批 10 组上评估
    • 报告时明确标注“seen pairs / upper bound”，不作为主指标

这样既满足“GT 纳入训练”，又不会用同一批数据自评自夸。

三、技术路线

Step 1：本地 LLM 关键词提取

  • LM Studio 本地模型：先对比 qwen2.5-coder-14b-instruct 与 deepseek-r1-0528-qwen3-8b
  • 输入：10 份 JD + 110 份 CV 的自然语言文本
  • 输出 JSON：skills / tools / domains / seniority / years / languages / location / certifications
  • 每个关键词带 term、category、importance、evidence
  • temperature=0；缓存 JSONL；失败重试；人工抽查 10 份

Step 2：合并/聚类关键词

  • 归一化 + 缩写/同义词映射
  • 用本地 nomic-embed-text 对关键词做 embedding
  • cosine + 层次聚类，合并相似词
  • 每个 cluster 选 canonical term
  • 输出词表、cluster 映射、文档–关键词矩阵
  • 人工检查 top 50 clusters，防止 Java/JavaScript 这类误合并

Step 3：AE 编码

  • 输入：110 CV + 10 JD 的关键词矩阵（TF-IDF 或 binary）
  • 结构：V → 512 → 128 → 32/64 → 128 → 512 → V
  • GELU + Dropout + BatchNorm；可选 denoising（mask 15%）
  • 损失：重构损失 + 监督 retrieval loss（GT pairs）
  • 输出：所有文档的 32/64 维向量
  • 基线：TF-IDF cosine、BM25、Nomic embedding cosine、关键词重叠

Step 4：Top-10 检索

  • 每个 GT JD 编码后，与 110 份 CV 向量算 cosine
  • 返回 Top-10
  • 保存排名、分数、命中的关键词证据

Step 5：Recall 评估

  • 主指标：Recall@10（每个 JD 只有 1 份相关 CV，所以等于 hit rate）
  • 辅助：Recall@5、MRR@10、平均排名
  • 报告 10 折均值 + 每个 query 结果 + Wilson 95% CI
  • 随机基线约 10/110 ≈ 9.1%，报告时作为参照
  • 同时对比 AE / AE+监督 / TF-IDF / BM25 / Nomic

Step 6：错误分析

每个未命中 query 分类：

  1. LLM 关键词漏抽/错抽
  2. 同义词聚类错误
  3. must-have 权重不足
  4. seniority / location / language 不匹配
  5. AE bottleneck 丢信息
  6. GT 本身存在歧义

再做消融：

  • 有/无监督 loss
  • 有/无关键词聚类
  • bottleneck 16/32/64/128
  • 有/无 denoising
  • LLM 关键词 vs 原始文本

Step 7：中英双语 PDF 报告

对，这个理解更准确：

Excel 是人工把原始 JD/CV 整理成结构化标签后的“参考版本”，不是 JD–CV 匹配标签。 它和 10 组 hired 的区别是：Excel 有技能/岗位等标签，但没有“谁匹配谁”；hired 有匹配关系，但没有结构化标签。

所以 Excel 不应该被丢掉，但也不应该被当成 Ground Truth。它最适合用在三个地方：

1. 验证 LLM 关键词抽取质量（silver reference）

  • 100 份 CV：Excel 的 Skills、Current title、Role family、Education 是人类整理好的标签；把 LLM 从 100 份 PDF 抽出的关键词与它对比，计算：

    • Jaccard 相似度
    • 技能覆盖率
  • 50 份 JD：Excel 的 Position、Role family、Country、Salary、Remote 等字段，可以和 LLM 从 JD 文本抽出的 role/location/salary/seniority 对比。

这能给 Step 1 一个量化质量指标，而不是只靠人工感觉。它只用于验证，不参与 Recall。

2. 扩充无监督语料

  • 50 份 JD 的 Job description 是自然语言文本，可以作为额外的未标注 JD，用于：
    • AE 预训练
    • 关键词聚类/词表构建
  • 但不能把 Excel 的标签直接作为 AE 输入，否则就绕过了“自然语言 → LLM 抽取关键词”这个作业核心。
  • 50 份 JD 与 10 份 GT JD 可能部分重叠；按标题/文本去重，重叠的从无监督语料中剔除，避免 leave-one-pair-out 泄漏。

3. 错误分析分层

用 Excel 的 Role family、Country、Salary 等字段解释：

  • 哪些岗位族更容易检索错？
  • 哪些地区/薪资段的 CV 更难匹配？
  • 是技能抽取问题，还是领域/资历问题？

助手 / Assistant · 207

接着上面 LOPO 的部分说：

如果同一批 10 组既参与训练又参与测试，Recall 一定会虚高，因为模型已经见过“这个 JD 对应这份 CV”。所以主评估不能用这种口径，而要用 leave-one-pair-out：

  • 一共 10 折
  • 每折留出 1 组 GT（JD + hired CV）
  • 用其余 9 组 + 100 份匿名 CV 训练
  • 用留出的 JD 在 110 份 CV 里检索 Top-10
  • 看 hired CV 是否在 Top-10
  • 10 折平均，得到主 Recall

这样每一组 GT 都进入过训练（9 次），但评估时用的是没见过的 JD–CV 对，指标才可信。另报一个“全部 10 组训练 + 同批评估”的 in-sample 上界，并明确标注。

具体怎么算

对每个 GT JD：

R(q) = { 该 JD 的 hired CV }        # 只有 1 个已知相关 CV
Top10(q) = 检索返回的前 10 份 CV
Recall@10(q) = |Top10(q) ∩ R(q)| / |R(q)|
             = 1 如果 hired CV 在 Top-10，否则 0

因为每个 JD 只有 1 个相关 CV，所以：

Recall@10 = HitRate@10

10 个 JD 平均：

Recall@10 = 命中数 / 10

举例：

JD hired CV 排名 Recall@10
P01 3 1
P02 14 0
P03 1 1
… … …
平均 0.8

候选池是 110 份 CV，随机检索的 Recall@10 大约是 10/110 ≈ 9.1%，报告里可以作为下限参照。

除了 Recall@10，还建议报：

  • Recall@5：更严格
  • MRR@10：mean(1 / rank)，命中越靠前越高
  • 平均排名：没进 Top-10 的按 11 或 110 计
  • 每个 query 的命中/未命中表

Precision@10 在这里意义不大：每个 JD 只有 1 个已知正例，即使排第 1，P@10 也只有 0.1。除非后面做人工扩充标签，否则不建议把 Precision 当主指标。

一个需要注意的问题：未标注的“好 CV”

100 份匿名 CV 里可能还有别的 CV 也符合这个 JD，只是没有标签。如果系统把“另一个好 CV”排进 Top-10，而 hired CV 没进，按严格口径会算 miss，但人工看可能是合理的。

所以报告里要写清楚：

这里的 Recall 是 conservative lower bound：只把“实际被雇佣的 CV”当作唯一已知相关项；未标注的潜在好匹配不计入。

如果你想把“符合 JD 的 CV”定义得更宽，可以加一个 pooled manual evaluation：

  1. 对每个 JD，收集 AE、TF-IDF、BM25、Nomic 四种方法的 Top-10
  2. 去重，得到每个 JD 约 20–30 份候选
  3. 人工判断每份 CV 是否“符合 JD”
  4. 用人工判断后的相关集合计算 Recall@10

这是信息检索里常用的 pooling 方法，能处理“一个 JD 有多个好 CV”的情况，但需要额外人工标注。10 个 JD × 20–30 份，大约 200–300 次判断，工作量可控。

建议的最终评估口径

  • 主指标：10 折 leave-one-pair-out 的 Recall@10
  • 辅助：Recall@5、MRR@10、平均排名
  • 上界：全部 10 组训练 + 同批评估的 in-sample Recall
  • 可选：pooled 人工判断后的 Recall@10
  • 基线：TF-IDF、BM25、Nomic embedding、关键词重叠
  • 对照：AE 重构 only vs AE + supervised contrastive

这样既回答了“关键词检索准不准”，也不会因为只有 10 组标签而把 Recall 算得虚高。

-- 10 hired CVs (positives)\n  cv_100.jsonl      -- 100 anonymised CVs\n  documents.jsonl   -- all 120 documents in one file\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport fitz  # PyMuPDF\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nRAW = ROOT / \"data\" / \"raw\"\nOUT = ROOT / \"data\" / \"processed\"\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n\ndef read_pdf(path: Path) -> str:\n    doc = fitz.open(path)\n    pages = [p.get_text() for p in doc]\n    return \"\\n\".join(pages)\n\n\ndef clean_lines(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Remove dataset headers/footers and page markers, keep content.\"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    for raw in text.splitlines():\n        line = raw.rstrip()\n        s = line.strip()\n        if not s:\n            out.append(\"\")\n            continue\n        if s.startswith(\"Anonymised example\"):\n            continue\n        if s.startswith(\"Anonymised candidate profile\"):\n            continue\n        if re.fullmatch(r\"P\\d{2} · page \\d+\", s):\n            continue\n        if re.fullmatch(r\"CV-\\d{3} · page \\d+\", s):\n            continue\n        if re.fullmatch(r\"CV-\\d{3}\", s):\n            continue\n        if re.fullmatch(r\"P\\d{2} · JOB DESCRIPTION · .+\", s):\n            continue\n        if re.fullmatch(r\"P\\d{2} · CV OF THE HIRED CANDIDATE\", s):\n            continue\n        if s.startswith(\"Hired for:\"):\n            continue\n        out.append(line)\n\n    # collapse 3+ blank lines to 1, trim\n    text = \"\\n\".join(out)\n    text = re.sub(r\"\\n{3,}\", \"\\n\\n\", text)\n    return text.strip()\n\n\ndef parse_pairs() -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict]]:\n    jds: list[dict] = []\n    cvs: list[dict] = []\n    for pdf in sorted((RAW / \"jd_cv_pairs\").glob(\"*.pdf\")):\n        pair_id = pdf.name.split(\" - \")[0].strip()\n        role = pdf.name.split(\" - \", 1)[1].rsplit(\".pdf\", 1)[0].strip()\n        text = read_pdf(pdf)\n        marker = \"CV OF THE HIRED CANDIDATE\"\n        if marker not in text:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Marker not found in {pdf.name}\")\n        jd_raw, cv_raw = text.split(marker, 1)\n        jd_text = clean_lines(jd_raw)\n        cv_text = clean_lines(cv_raw)\n\n        jds.append(\n            {\n                \"doc_id\": f\"JD_{pair_id}\",\n                \"doc_type\": \"jd\",\n                \"pair_id\": pair_id,\n                \"role_title\": role,\n                \"source_file\": pdf.name,\n                \"text\": jd_text,\n            }\n        )\n        cvs.append(\n            {\n                \"doc_id\": f\"HIRED_{pair_id}\",\n                \"doc_type\": \"cv\",\n                \"pair_id\": pair_id,\n                \"role_title\": role,\n                \"source_file\": pdf.name,\n                \"text\": cv_text,\n                \"is_hired\": True,\n            }\n        )\n    return jds, cvs\n\n\ndef parse_cvs() -> list[dict]:\n    rows: list[dict] = []\n    for pdf in sorted((RAW / \"cvs_100\").glob(\"*.pdf\")):\n        cv_id = pdf.stem\n        text = clean_lines(read_pdf(pdf))\n        rows.append(\n            {\n                \"doc_id\": cv_id,\n                \"doc_type\": \"cv\",\n                \"pair_id\": None,\n                \"source_file\": pdf.name,\n                \"text\": text,\n                \"is_hired\": False,\n            }\n        )\n    return rows\n\n\ndef write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:\n    with path.open(\"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        for row in rows:\n            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    jds, hired = parse_pairs()\n    cvs = parse_cvs()\n    write_jsonl(OUT / \"jd_10.jsonl\", jds)\n    write_jsonl(OUT / \"hired_cv_10.jsonl\", hired)\n    write_jsonl(OUT / \"cv_100.jsonl\", cvs)\n    write_jsonl(OUT / \"documents.jsonl\", jds + hired + cvs)\n\n    print(f\"JDs: {len(jds)}\")\n    print(f\"hired CVs: {len(hired)}\")\n    print(f\"anonymised CVs: {len(cvs)}\")\n    print(f\"documents: {len(jds) + len(hired) + len(cvs)}\")\n    print(\"\\nJD lengths:\")\n    for r in jds:\n        print(f\"  {r['doc_id']}: {len(r['text'])} chars | {r['role_title']}\")\n    print(\"\\nSample JD head:\")\n    print(jds[0][\"text\"][:500])\n    print(\"\\nSample hired CV head:\")\n    print(hired[0][\"text\"][:500])\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"
}

]\n}}\n\nDOCUMENT TYPE: {doc_type}\nDOCUMENT ID: {doc_id}\nDOCUMENT:\n{text}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef post_chat(messages: list[dict], max_tokens: int = 1400) -> str:\n    payload = {\n        \"model\": start = text.find(\"{\")\n        end = text.rfind(\"}\")\n        if start >= 0 and end > start:\n            return json.loads(text[start : end + 1])\n        raise\n\n\ndef extract(doc: dict, \"system\", \"content\": SYSTEM},\n        {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": prompt},\n    ]\n    last_err = None\n    for attempt in range(retries + 1):\n        try:\n            raw = post_chat(messages)\n            obj = parse_json(raw)\n            obj[\"doc_id\"] = doc[\"doc_id\"]\n            obj[\"doc_type\"] = doc[\"doc_type\"]\n            obj[\"role_title\"] = doc.get(\"role_title\") or obj.get(\"role_title\")\n            obj[\"_raw_response\"] = raw\n            return obj\n        except Exception as e:\n            last_err = e\n            time.sleep(2 return doc_ids, X_tfidf, X_counts, pairs, idx_of, cv_ids, jd_ids\n\n\ndef rank_of(scores: np.ndarray, pos: int) -> int:\n    order = np.argsort(-scores)\n    return int(np.where(order == pos)[0][0]) +   "content": "\"\"\"Validate the LLM keyword profiles and print coverage statistics.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nfrom collections import Counter\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nKEYWORDS = ROOT / \"outputs\" / \"keywords\" / \"all_keywords.jsonl\"\nOUT = ROOT / \"outputs\" / \"metrics\"\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    docs = [json.loads(line) for line in KEYWORDS.open(encoding=\"utf-8\")]\n    ids = [d.get(\"doc_id\") for d in docs]\n    dup = [k for k, v in Counter(ids).items() if v > 1]\n    cats = Counter()\n    bad = []\n    counts = []\n    for d in docs:\n        kws = d.get(\"keywords\", [])\n        counts.append(len(kws))\n        if not kws:\n            bad.append(d.get(\"doc_id\"))\n        for k in kws:\n            cats[k.get(\"category\", \"MISSING\")] += 1\n            if not k.get(\"term\") or k.get(\"importance\") not in (1, 2, 3):\n                bad.append(d.get(\"doc_id\"))\n                break\n    summary = {\n        \"documents\": len(docs),\n        \"unique_ids\": len(set(ids)),\n        \"duplicates\": dup,\n        \"documents_without_keywords\": sorted(set(bad)),\n        \"keyword_count\": {\n            \"min\": min(counts),\n            \"max\": max(counts),\n            \"mean\": round(sum(counts) / len(counts), 2),\n        },\n        \"categories\": dict(cats.most_common()),\n    }\n    (OUT / \"keyword_validation.json\").write_text(\n        json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\"\n    )\n    print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"
}

{
  "path": "D:\\softs_usual\\opencode_windows\\stat6207_final_groupproject\\HW4_6207\\README.md",
  "content": "# HW4 6207 — Keyword-Based CV–JD Matching\n\nThis project builds a keyword-based retrieval pipeline for CV–JD matching:\n\n1. A **local LLM** (LM Studio, `qwen2.5-coder-14b-instruct`) extracts keywords from natural-language JDs and CVs.\n2. Keywords are normalised and clustered with a **non-LLM** pipeline (alias rules + character n-gram TF-IDF + agglomerative clustering).\n3. A **PyTorch autoencoder** encodes the document–keyword matrix.\n4. For each of the 10 ground-truth JDs, the system retrieves the **top-10 CVs** from a pool of 110 CVs.\n5. Retrieval is evaluated with **Recall@10** (primary), Recall@5, MRR@10 and mean rank.\n6. Error analysis and a **bilingual (Chinese/English) PDF report** are produced.\n\n## Data (no Excel)\n\n- `data/raw/cvs_100/`: 100 anonymised CV PDFs (`CV-001` … `CV-100`).\n- `data/raw/jd_cv_pairs/`: 10 PDFs (`P01` … `P10`); each contains a JD followed by\n  `CV OF THE HIRED CANDIDATE`. The JD is the query and the hired CV is the\n  positive candidate.\n- `data/processed/ground_truth.json`: 10 `(jd_id, cv_id)` pairs.\n- Candidate pool: **100 anonymised CVs + 10 hired CVs = 110 CVs**.\n- The Manatal Excel file is **not used** in this task.\n\n## Pipeline\n\n```powershell\n# 1. parse PDFs\npython src/parse_data.py\n\n# 2. local LLM keyword extraction (resume-safe)\npython src/extract_keywords.py --out all_keywords.jsonl\n# fast mode for the 100 CVs:\npython src/extract_keywords.py --fast --resume --out all_keywords.jsonl\n\n# 3. keyword normalisation / clustering / document-term matrix\npython src/cluster_keywords.py\n\n# 4. baselines + AE retrieval (leave-one-pair-out primary)\npython src/train_eval.py --mode all --epochs 120 --bottleneck 64\n\n# 5. validate keyword extraction\npython src/validate_keywords.py\n\n# 6. bilingual report\npython src/make_report.py\n```\n\n## Evaluation protocol\n\n- **Primary:** leave-one-pair-out (10 folds). Each fold trains on 9 GT pairs + the\n  100 unlabelled CVs, then evaluates the held-out JD against the 110-CV pool.\n- **Upper bound:** train on all 10 pairs and evaluate the same 10 (`in_sample`).\n- **Baselines:** TF-IDF cosine, keyword-overlap cosine, BM25.\n- **Metrics:** Recall@10, Recall@5, MRR@10, mean rank, Wilson 95% CI.\n\n## Directory layout\n\n```text\nHW4_6207/\n├─ data/raw/                 # copied PDFs\n├─ data/processed/           # parsed JSONL + ground truth\n├─ src/                      # pipeline scripts\n├─ outputs/keywords/         # LLM keyword profiles\n├─ outputs/clusters/         # vocabulary, clusters, matrices\n├─ outputs/models/           # AE weights / embeddings\n├─ outputs/retrieval/        # per-query rankings\n├─ outputs/metrics/          # metrics + error analysis\n├─ report/                   # bilingual HTML/PDF + figures\n└─ README.md\n```\n\n## Notes\n\n- Keyword extraction is prompt-based; the local LLM is **not fine-tuned**.\n- The AE is trained from scratch; the supervised retrieval loss uses the 10 GT pairs.\n- Since only 10 labelled pairs exist, LOPO is the honest estimate; in-sample is an upper bound.\n- The report clearly separates measured facts from proposed improvements.\n"
}

(in-sample)\",\n    \"ae_supervised_lopo\": \"AE + sup. (LOPO)\",\n}\n\n\ndef load():\n    metrics = json.loads((MET / \"metrics.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    rows = list(csv.DictReader((RET / \"per_query.csv\").open(encoding=\"utf-8\")))\n    err = []\n    if (MET / \"error_analysis.json\").exists():\n        err = json.loads((MET / \"error_analysis.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    clusters = json.loads((CLU / \"keyword_clusters.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    return metrics, rows, err, clusters\n\n\ndef fig_to_b64(path: Path) -> str:\n    return base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode(\"ascii\")\n\n\ndef make_figures(metrics, rows, clusters):\n    # 1. Recall@10 bars\n    names = [k for k in METHOD_LABELS if k in metrics]\n    vals = [metrics[k][\"recall@10\"] for k in names]\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2, 3.2), dpi=180)\n    colors = [\"#9DB4C0\"] * len(names)\n    for i, n in enumerate(names):\n        if n.startswith(\"ae_supervised_lopo\"):\n            colors[i] = \"#0E7C86\"\n    ax.barh([METHOD_LABELS[n] for n in names], vals, color=colors, height=0.55)\n    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)\n    ax.set_xlabel(\"Recall@10\")\n    ax.set_title(\"Recall@10 by method (higher is better)\")\n    for i, v in enumerate(vals):\n        ax.text(v + 0.01, i, f\"{v:.2f}\", va=\"center\", fontsize=8)\n    ax.grid(axis=\"x\", alpha=0.25)\n    fig.tight_layout()\n    p1 = FIG / \"fig_recall10.png\"\n    fig.savefig(p1, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n    plt.close(fig)\n\n    # 2. per-query ranks for LOPO\n    lopo = [r for r in rows if r[\"method\"] == \"ae_supervised_lopo\"]\n    lopo = sorted(lopo, key=lambda r: r[\"pair_id\"])\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2, 3.0), dpi=180)\n    if lopo:\n        ranks = [int(r[\"rank\"]) for r in lopo]\n        labels = [r[\"pair_id\"] for r in lopo]\n        cols = [\"#0E7C86\" if x <= 10 else \"#C96A2B\" for x in ranks]\n        ax.bar(labels, ranks, color=cols, width=0.6)\n        ax.axhline(10, color=\"#333\", linestyle=\"--\", linewidth=1)\n        ax.text(len(labels) - 0.4, 10.5, \"Top-10 cutoff\", ha=\"right\", fontsize=8)\n        ax.invert_yaxis()\n        ax.set_ylabel(\"Rank of hired CV (lower is better)\")\n        ax.set_title(\"LOPO: rank of the held-out hired CV\")\n        for i, v in enumerate(ranks):\n            ax.text(i, v + 2, str(v), ha=\"center\", fontsize=8)\n    fig.tight_layout()\n    p2 = FIG / \"fig_lopo_ranks.png\"\n    fig.savefig(p2, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n    plt.close(fig)\n\n    # 3. top clusters\n    top = clusters[:12]\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2, 3.4), dpi=180)\n    ax.barh([c[\"canonical\"] for c in top][::-1], [c[\"doc_freq\"] for c in top][::-1], color=\"#0E7C86\")\n    ax.set_xlabel(\"Document frequency\")\n    ax.set_title(\"Largest keyword clusters\")\n    fig.tight_layout()\n    p3 = FIG / \"fig_clusters.png\"\n    fig.savefig(p3, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n    plt.close(fig)\n    return p1, p2, p3\n\n\ndef metric_table(metrics):\n    names = [k for k in METHOD_LABELS if k in metrics]\n    head = \"<tr><th>Method</th><th>Recall@10</th><th>Recall@5</th><th>MRR@10</th><th>Mean rank</th><th>95% CI (R@10)</th></tr>\"\n    body = []\n    for k in names:\n        m = metrics[k]\n        body.append(\n            f\"<tr><td>{METHOD_LABELS[k]}</td><td>{m['recall@10']:.3f}</td>\"\n            f\"<td>{m['recall@5']:.3f}</td><td>{m['mrr@10']:.3f}</td>\"\n            f\"<td>{m['mean_rank']:.1f}</td>\"\n            f\"<td>[{m['ci95_recall@10'][0]:.3f}, {m['ci95_recall@10'][1]:.3f}]</td></tr>\"\n        )\n    return f\"<table class='data'>{head}{''.join(body)}</table>\"\n\n\ndef per_query_table(rows):\n    lopo = sorted([r for r in rows if r[\"method\"] == \"ae_supervised_lopo\"], key=lambda r: r[\"pair_id\"])\n    head = \"<tr><th>Pair</th><th>JD</th><th>Hired CV</th><th>Rank</th><th>Hit@10</th><th>Top-1 returned</th></tr>\"\n    body = []\n    for r in lopo:\n        top1 = r[\"top10\"].split(\"|\")[0] if r[\"top10\"] else \"\"\n        cls = \"hit\" if int(r[\"recall@10\"]) else \"miss\"\n        body.append(\n            f\"<tr class='{cls}'><td>{r['pair_id']}</td><td>{r['jd_id']}</td>\"\n            f\"<td>{r['cv_id']}</td><td>{r['rank']}</td>\"\n            f\"<td>{'✓' if int(r['recall@10']) else '✗'}</td><td>{top1}</td></tr>\"\n        )\n    return f\"<table class='data'>{head}{''.join(body)}</table>\"\n\n\ndef error_table(err):\n    head = \"<tr><th>Pair</th><th>Rank</th><th>Top-1</th><th>JD∩positive</th><th>Missing from positive</th></tr>\"\n    body = []\n    for e in err:\n        if e[\"hit@10\"]:\n            continue\n        body.append(\n            f\"<tr><td>{e['pair_id']}</td><td>{e['rank']}</td><td>{e['top1']}</td>\"\n            f\"<td>{', '.join(e['overlap_jd_positive'][:6])}</td>\"\n            f\"<td>{', '.join(e['missing_from_positive'][:6])}</td></tr>\"\n        )\n    if not body:\n        body.append(\"<tr><td colspan='5'>No LOPO misses — all held-out hired CVs were in the top 10.</td></tr>\")\n    return f\"<table class='data'>{head}{''.join(body)}</table>\"\n\n\ndef main():\n    metrics, rows, err, clusters = load()\n    p1, p2, p3 = make_figures(metrics, rows, clusters)\n    lopo = metrics.get(\"ae_supervised_lopo\", {})\n    base = metrics.get(\"tfidf_cosine\", {})\n    lopo_r = lopo.get(\"recall@10\", float(\"nan\"))\n    base_r = base.get(\"recall@10\", float(\"nan\"))\n    delta = (lopo_r - base_r) if (lopo and base) else float(\"nan\")\n\n    html = f\"\"\"<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"zh-CN\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n<title>HW4 6207 · 关键词驱动的 CV–JD 匹配 / Keyword-Based CV–JD Matching</title>\n<style>\n@page {{ size: A4; margin: 17mm 16mm 16mm; }}\n* {{ class=\"cover\">\n  <div class=\"kicker\">STAT6207 · HW4 · BILINGUAL EXPERIMENT REPORT</div>\n  <h1>关键词驱动的 CV–JD 匹配<br><span style=\"font-size:19pt;\">Keyword-Based CV–JD Matching</span></h1>\n  <div class=\"sub\">本地 LLM 关键词抽取 · 关键词聚类 · 自编码器检索<br>\n  Local LLM extraction · keyword clustering · autoencoder retrieval</div>\n  <div class=\"meta\">\n    <span class=\"tag\">10 GT pairs</span><span class=\"tag\">110 CVs</span><span class=\"tag\">Top-10 retrieval</span><br>\n    数据 Data: Anonymised-CVs-100 + JD + Hired CV examples<br>\n    模型 Model: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct (LM Studio, local)<br>\n    日期 Date: 2026-11-07\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"pagebreak\"></div>\n<h2>摘要 / Abstract</h2>\n<p>本项目研究在职位描述（JD）与简历（CV）均为非结构化自然语言的条件下，如何用“本地 LLM 关键词抽取 → 关键词合并/聚类 → 自编码器编码 → 向量检索”的流水线完成 CV–JD 匹配。数据包含 10 份带“实际被雇佣 CV”的标准 JD–CV 对，以及 100 份匿名 CV；候选池共 110 份 CV。关键词由本地 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct 抽取，后续聚类、编码和检索均由非 LLM 程序完成。主评估采用 leave-one-pair-out（LOPO）：每折用 9 组 GT + 100 份无标签 CV 训练，留出 1 组评估，10 折平均。主指标为 Recall@10，并报告 Recall@5、MRR@10、平均排名与 Wilson 95% 置信区间。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">This project studies CV–JD matching when both job descriptions (JDs) and CVs are unstructured natural language. The pipeline is: local-LLM keyword extraction → keyword merging/clustering → autoencoder encoding → vector retrieval. The data contain 10 standard JD–CV pairs with the actual hired CV, plus 100 anonymised CVs, giving a 110-CV candidate pool. Keywords are extracted by a local Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct model; clustering, encoding and retrieval are non-LLM programs. The primary evaluation is leave-one-pair-out (LOPO): each fold trains on 9 GT pairs + 100 unlabelled CVs and evaluates the held-out pair. The primary metric is Recall@10, with Recall@5, MRR@10, mean rank and Wilson 95% CI.</p>\n\n<div class=\"note\"><b>主要结果 / Key result:</b> LOPO Recall@10 = <b>{lopo_r:.3f}</b>;\nTF-IDF baseline = <b>{base_r:.3f}</b>; Δ = <b>{delta:+.3f}</b>.\nIn-sample upper bound = <b>{metrics.get('ae_supervised_in_sample', {}).get('recall@10', float('nan')):.3f}</b>.</div>\n\n<h2>1. 任务与数据 / Task and Data</h2>\n<h3>1.1 任务定义 / Task definition</h3>\n<p>给定一份 JD 和一组 CV，系统需要返回与 JD 最匹配的前 10 份 CV。匹配信号只来自自然语言文本中抽取出的关键词，不使用人工匹配标签作为输入特征；10 组 GT 只用于监督训练和评估。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">Given a JD and a pool of CVs, the system returns the top-10 best-matching CVs. The matching signal comes only from keywords extracted from natural-language text; human match labels are never used as input features. The 10 GT pairs are used only for supervised training and evaluation.</p>\n\n<h3>1.2 数据 / Data</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><b>10 份标准 JD</b>：来自 <code>JD + Hired CV examples</code> 每份 PDF 的前半部分；自然语言职位描述。</li>\n<li><b>10 份 hired CV</b>：同一 PDF 的 <code>CV OF THE HIRED CANDIDATE</code> 部分；作为每份 JD 的唯一已知正例。</li>\n<li><b>100 份匿名 CV</b>：<code>Anonymised-CVs-100</code>；作为无标签候选与无监督训练语料。</li>\n<li><b>候选池</b>：100 + 10 = <b>110 份 CV</b>。10 份 hired CV 不在 100 份匿名 CV 中。</li>\n<li><b>Excel 未使用</b>：本任务不依赖 Manatal 表的结构化标签。</li>\n</ul>\n<p class=\"en\">Ten standard JDs and their hired CVs come from the 10 PDFs; 100 anonymised CVs provide unlabelled candidates and unsupervised training data. The candidate pool is 110 CVs. The Manatal Excel file is not used.</p>\n\n<h2>2. 方法 / Method</h2>\n<h3>2.1 本地 LLM 关键词抽取 / Local LLM keyword extraction</h3>\n<p>使用 LM Studio 本地部署的 <b>Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct</b>，temperature=0，要求模型输出固定 JSON schema。JD 与 CV 使用同一 schema：<code>role_title</code>、<code>seniority</code>、<code>years_experience</code>、<code>location</code>、<code>languages</code>、<code>keywords[]</code>；每个关键词包含 <code>term</code>、<code>category</code>、<code>importance</code>（1–3）。抽取结果写入 JSONL 并缓存，支持断点续跑。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">We use a locally deployed <b>Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct</b> via LM Studio at temperature 0, with a fixed JSON schema. Each keyword has a term, category and importance (1–3). Results are cached as JSONL with resume support.</p>\n\n<h3>2.2 关键词合并与聚类 / Keyword merging and clustering</h3>\n<p>先做别名归一化（如 JS→JavaScript、Golang→Go、Postgres→PostgreSQL），再用字符 n-gram TF-IDF + 层次聚类合并相似关键词；<code>java</code>、<code>javascript</code>、<code>sql</code> 等易混词设为保护词，避免误合并。每个 cluster 选择文档频率最高的词作为 canonical term，最终构建 120 份文档 × 词表的 TF-IDF 矩阵。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">Alias normalisation is followed by character n-gram TF-IDF and agglomerative clustering. Ambiguous terms such as Java/JavaScript and SQL are protected from merging. Each cluster gets a canonical term, yielding a 120-document × vocabulary TF-IDF matrix.</p>\n\n<h3>2.3 自编码器 / Autoencoder</h3>\n<p>AE 结构为 <code>V → 512 → 256 → 64 → 256 → 512 → V</code>，使用 GELU、Dropout、AdamW 和 denoising reconstruction。除重构损失外，在 bottleneck 上加入 supervised contrastive / listwise retrieval loss：每个 JD 的 positive 是它的 hired CV，其余 109 份 CV 为 negatives。这样 AE 既学习文档表示，也直接从 10 组 GT 学习“匹配”。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">The AE is <code>V → 512 → 256 → 64 → 256 → 512 → V</code> with GELU, dropout, AdamW and denoising reconstruction. A supervised listwise retrieval loss is added on the bottleneck: the hired CV is the positive and the other 109 CVs are negatives. The AE therefore learns both document representation and matching from the 10 GT pairs.</p>\n\n<h3>2.4 检索与评估 / Retrieval and evaluation</h3>\n<p>JD 与 CV 均编码为 64 维单位向量，按 cosine similarity 排序，返回 Top-10。主评估为 leave-one-pair-out：每折留出 1 组 GT，用其余 9 组 + 100 份匿名 CV 训练，再在 110 份 CV 中检索；10 折平均。另报全部 10 组训练的 in-sample 上界，以及 TF-IDF、关键词重叠、BM25 三个无监督基线。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">JDs and CVs are encoded into 64-d unit vectors and ranked by cosine similarity. The primary LOPO protocol holds out one GT pair per fold, trains on the other 9 pairs + 100 unlabelled CVs, and retrieves from the 110-CV pool. We also report an in-sample upper bound and three unsupervised baselines: TF-IDF, keyword overlap and BM25.</p>\n\n<h2>3. 实验结果 / Results</h2>\n<div class=\"note\"><b>Recall@10 definition:</b> for each JD, 1 if the hired CV appears in the top 10, else 0; average over 10 queries. With one relevant CV per query, Recall@10 equals HitRate@10.</div>\n{metric_table(metrics)}\n<div class=\"fig\"><img src=\"data:image/png;base64,{fig_to_b64(p1)}\"><div class=\"cap\">图 1 / Figure 1. Recall@10 by method.</div></div>\n<div class=\"fig\"><img src=\"data:image/png;base64,{fig_to_b64(p2)}\"><div class=\"cap\">图 2 / Figure 2. LOPO: rank of the held-out hired CV (lower is better; dashed line = Top-10 cutoff).</div></div>\n{per_query_table(rows)}\n\n<h2>4. 错误分析 / Error Analysis</h2>\n<p>下表列出 LOPO 中未命中（rank &gt; 10）的案例。最后一列是 JD 中出现、但 positive CV 未覆盖的关键词，用于区分“关键词抽取/聚类问题”和“候选人确实缺少 must-have 技能”。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">The table lists LOPO misses (rank &gt; 10). The last column shows JD keywords missing from the positive CV, separating extraction/clustering errors from genuine must-have gaps.</p>\n{error_table(err)}\n<div class=\"fig\"><img src=\"data:image/png;base64,{fig_to_b64(p3)}\"><div class=\"cap\">图 3 / Figure 3. Largest keyword clusters (document frequency).</div></div>\n\n<h3>4.1 主要观察 / Main observations</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><b>关键词覆盖与排序：</b>命中案例中，hired CV 与 JD 的 must-have 关键词重合度高；未命中案例通常是 JD 的领域词/工具词在 positive CV 中缺失，或 top-1 候选共享了更通用的关键词。</li>\n<li><b>AE vs 基线：</b>AE 的优势在于压缩后的语义向量能缓解同义词/拼写差异；但如果关键词聚类把 must-have 与 nice-to-have 混在一起，AE 也会被通用词主导。</li>\n<li><b>LOPO vs in-sample：</b>in-sample 明显更高，说明 10 组 GT 的监督信号很容易被模型记住；LOPO 才是可信估计。</li>\n</ul>\n<p class=\"en\">Hits generally have strong must-have overlap between JD and hired CV; misses often reflect missing domain/tool terms or a top-1 candidate with more generic keywords. The gap between in-sample and LOPO shows that 10 pairs are easy to memorise; LOPO is the honest estimate.</p>\n\n<h2>5. 改进方案 / Improvements</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><b>Must-have 加权：</b>把 JD 中 importance=3 的关键词单独作为门槛；缺少关键 must-have 的 CV 降权或直接过滤。</li>\n<li><b>混合检索：</b>AE 向量 + BM25 / 关键词重叠的 hybrid score，兼顾语义与精确术语。</li>\n<li><b>更好的关键词归一化：</b>扩展技能同义词表，区分 Java/JavaScript、SQL/MySQL、AWS/Azure/GCP 等易混词。</li>\n<li><b>更多 GT：</b>10 组标签太少；建议人工补充 30–50 组 JD–CV 相关性判断，或做 pooled 人工评估。</li>\n<li><b>类别感知编码：</b>按 skill/tool/domain 分块编码，避免通用职责词压过硬技能。</li>\n</ul>\n<p class=\"en\">Recommendations: must-have gating, hybrid AE+BM25 retrieval, stronger skill normalisation, more labelled pairs, and category-aware encoding.</p>\n\n<h2>6. 局限 / Limitations</h2>\n<ul>\n<li>只有 10 组 GT，Recall 的统计置信区间较宽；10 个 query 的粒度是 0.1。</li>\n<li>Recall 只把“实际 hired CV”视为相关；其他潜在好 CV 未标注，因此指标偏保守。</li>\n<li>候选池 110 份，规模较小；结论不应直接外推到大规模招聘。</li>\n<li>LLM 抽取存在类别漂移和漏抽；本报告未做大规模人工校对。</li>\n</ul>\n<p class=\"en\">Only 10 GT pairs; wide CIs and 0.1 granularity. Recall treats only the hired CV as relevant, so it is conservative. The 110-CV pool is small. LLM extraction has category drift and misses; no large-scale human audit was performed.</p>\n\n<h2>附录 / Appendix</h2>\n<h3>A.   "content": "\"\"\"Merge/normalise keywords and build the document-term matrix.\n\nPipeline:\n  alias normalisation -> Nomic keyword embeddings (local LM Studio)\n  -> agglomerative clustering -> canonical term -> TF-IDF matrix.\n\nIf the embedding endpoint is unavailable, falls back to character n-gram TF-IDF.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport re\nimport urllib.request\nfrom collections import Counter, defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nfrom sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering\nfrom sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfTransformer, TfidfVectorizer\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nKEYWORDS = ROOT / \"outputs\" / \"keywords\" / \"all_keywords.jsonl\"\nOUT = ROOT / \"outputs\" / \"clusters\"\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\nEMBED_API = \"http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1/embeddings\"\nEMBED_MODEL = \"nomic-embed\"\n\nALIASES = {\n    \"js\": \"javascript\",\n    \"ts\": \"typescript\",\n    \"golang\": \"go\",\n    \"go lang\": \"go\",\n    \"postgres\": \"postgresql\",\n    \"postgre sql\": \"postgresql\",\n    \"gcp\": \"google cloud platform\",\n    \"google cloud\": \"google cloud platform\",\n    \"aws\": \"amazon web services\",\n    \"amazon web services\": \"amazon web services\",\n    \"ml\": \"machine learning\",\n    \"ai\": \"artificial intelligence\",\n    \"ci cd\": \"ci/cd\",\n    \"ci/cd\": \"ci/cd\",\n    \"rest\": \"rest api\",\n    \"restful\": \"rest api\",\n    \"restful api\": \"rest api\",\n    \"reactjs\": \"react\",\n    \"react.js\": \"react\",\n    \"vuejs\": \"vue\",\n    \"vue.js\": \"vue\",\n    \"nodejs\": \"node.js\",\n    \"node\": \"node.js\",\n    \"k8s\": \"kubernetes\",\n    \"ms sql\": \"microsoft sql server\",\n    \"sql server\": \"microsoft sql server\",\n    \"powerbi\": \"power bi\",\n    \"nlp\": \"natural language processing\",\n    \"llm\": \"large language model\",\n    \"llms\": \"large language model\",\n    \"oop\": \"object-oriented programming\",\n    \"tdd\": \"test-driven development\",\n    \"c sharp\": \"c#\",\n    \"c plus plus\": \"c++\",\n}\n\nPROTECTED = {\n    \"java\", \"javascript\", \"c\", \"c++\", \"c#\", \"sql\", \"mysql\", \"postgresql\",\n    \"react\", \"react native\", \"amazon web services\", \"azure\",\n    \"google cloud platform\", \"docker\", \"kubernetes\",\n}\n\n\ndef norm_term(term: str) -> str:\n    t = term.strip().lower()\n    t = t.replace(\"&\", \" and \")\n    t = re.sub(r\"[\\(\\)\\[\\]\\{\\}]\", \" \", t)\n    t = re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \" \", t).strip(\" .,;:-\")\n    return ALIASES.get(t, t)\n\n\ndef embed_terms(terms: list[str]) -> np.ndarray:\n    vectors = []\n    for i in range(0, len(terms), 64):\n        batch = terms[i : i + 64]\n        payload = {\"model\": EMBED_MODEL, \"input\": batch}\n        req = urllib.request.Request(\n            EMBED_API,\n            data=json.dumps(payload).encode(\"utf-8\"),\n            headers={\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"},\n        )\n        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:\n            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))\n        vectors.extend([x[\"embedding\"] for x in data[\"data\"]])\n    X = np.asarray(vectors, dtype=np.float32)\n    X = X / (np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-9)\n    return X\n\n\ndef cluster_terms(terms: list[str], use_embeddings: bool = True):\n    if use_embeddings:\n        try:\n            X = embed_terms(terms)\n            print(f\"embedded {len(terms)} terms with {EMBED_MODEL}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"embedding failed ({e}); falling back to char TF-IDF\")\n            use_embeddings = False\n    if not use_embeddings:\n        vec = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer=\"char_wb\", ngram_range=(3, 5), min_df=1)\n        X = vec.fit_transform(terms).toarray()\n    cl = AgglomerativeClustering(\n        n_clusters=None,\n        distance_threshold=0.25 if use_embeddings else 0.30,\n        metric=\"cosine\",\n        linkage=\"average\",\n    )\n    cl.fit(X)\n    return cl.labels_\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--no-embed\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    docs = [json.loads(line) for line in KEYWORDS.open(encoding=\"utf-8\")]\n    print(f\"loaded {len(docs)} keyword profiles\")\n\n    variants: dict[str, Counter] = defaultdict(Counter)\n    doc_terms: list[dict] = []\n    for doc in docs:\n        terms = []\n        seen = set()\n        for kw in doc.get(\"keywords\", []):\n            raw = str(kw.get(\"term\", \"\")).strip()\n            if not raw:\n                continue\n            t = norm_term(raw)\n            if not t:\n                continue\n            imp = int(kw.get(\"importance\", 1) or 1)\n            variants[t][raw] += 1\n            if t not in seen:\n                terms.append((t, imp))\n                seen.add(t)\n        doc_terms.append({\"doc_id\": doc[\"doc_id\"], \"terms\": terms})\n\n    unique_terms = sorted(variants)\n    print(f\"unique normalised keywords: {len(unique_terms)}\")\n\n    protected = [t for t in unique_terms if t in PROTECTED]\n    candidate = [t for t in unique_terms if t not in PROTECTED]\n\n    labels = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(protected)}\n    next_id = len(protected)\n    if candidate:\n        labs = cluster_terms(candidate, use_embeddings=not args.no_embed)\n        for term, lab in zip(candidate, labs):\n            labels[term] = next_id + int(lab)\n        next_id += len(set(labs))\n\n    groups: dict[int, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)\n    for term, lab in labels.items():\n        groups[lab].append(term)\n\n    def total_imp(term: str) -> int:\n        return sum(imp for d in doc_terms for t, imp in d[\"terms\"] if t == term)\n\n    def doc_freq(term: str) -> int:\n        return sum(1 for d in doc_terms if any(t == term for t, _ in d[\"terms\"]))\n\n    clusters = []\n    term_to_cluster: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for cid, terms in groups.items():\n        terms_sorted = sorted(terms, key=lambda t: (-total_imp(t), -doc_freq(t), t))\n        canonical = terms_sorted[0]\n        for t in terms:\n            term_to_cluster[t] = cid\n        clusters.append(\n            {\n                \"cluster_id\": cid,\n                \"canonical\": canonical,\n                \"variants\": sorted(terms),\n                \"doc_freq\": doc_freq(canonical),\n                \"total_importance\": total_imp(canonical),\n            }\n        )\n    clusters.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[\"doc_freq\"], -x[\"total_importance\"], x[\"canonical\"]))\n    cluster_ids = [c[\"cluster_id\"] for c in clusters]\n    canonical_by_cluster = {c[\"cluster_id\"]: c[\"canonical\"] for c in clusters}\n\n    doc_ids = [d[\"doc_id\"] for d in docs]\n    vocab = [canonical_by_cluster[cid] for cid in cluster_ids]\n    idx = {cid: i for i, cid in enumerate(cluster_ids)}\n    counts = np.zeros((len(docs), len(vocab)), dtype=np.float32)\n    for i, d in enumerate(doc_terms):\n        for term, imp in d[\"terms\"]:\n            counts[i, idx[term_to_cluster[term]]] += float(imp)\n\n    tfidf = TfidfTransformer(norm=\"l2\", use_idf=True, smooth_idf=True)\n    X = tfidf.fit_transform(counts).astype(np.float32).toarray()\n\n    np.save(OUT / \"doc_term_counts.npy\", counts)\n    np.save(OUT / \"doc_term_tfidf.npy\", X)\n    (OUT / \"doc_ids.json\").write_text(json.dumps(doc_ids, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    (OUT / \"vocab.json\").write_text(json.dumps(vocab, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    (OUT / \"keyword_clusters.json\").write_text(\n        json.dumps(clusters, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\"\n    )\n    with (OUT / \"doc_terms.jsonl\").open(\"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        for d in doc_terms:\n            f.write(json.dumps(\n                {\n                    \"doc_id\": d[\"doc_id\"],\n                    \"terms\": [\n                        {\"term\": canonical_by_cluster[term_to_cluster[t]], \"importance\": imp}\n                        for t, imp in d[\"terms\"]\n                    ],\n                },\n                ensure_ascii=False,\n            ) + \"\\n\")\n\n    print(f\"clusters: {len(clusters)}; vocab: {len(vocab)}; matrix: {counts.shape}\")\n    print(\"top clusters:\")\n    for c in clusters[:20]:\n        print(f\"  {c['canonical']!r}: {c['variants']} (df={c['doc_freq']})\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"

  "oldString": "<p>先做别名归一化（如 JS→JavaScript、Golang→Go、Postgres→PostgreSQL），再用字符 n-gram TF-IDF + 层次聚类合并相似关键词；<code>java</code>、<code>javascript</code>、<code>sql</code> 等易混词设为保护词，避免误合并。每个 cluster 选择文档频率最高的词作为 canonical term，最终构建 120 份文档 × 词表的 TF-IDF 矩阵。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">Alias normalisation is followed by character n-gram TF-IDF and agglomerative clustering. Ambiguous terms such as Java/JavaScript and SQL are protected from merging. Each cluster gets a canonical term, yielding a 120-document × vocabulary TF-IDF matrix.</p>",
  "newString": "<p>先做别名归一化（如 JS→JavaScript、Golang→Go、Postgres→PostgreSQL），再用本地 Nomic embedding 模型（非生成式 LLM）对关键词向量化，并用 cosine + 层次聚类合并相似词；<code>java</code>、<code>javascript</code>、<code>sql</code> 等易混词设为保护词，避免误合并。每个 cluster 选择文档频率最高的词作为 canonical term，最终构建 120 份文档 × 词表的 TF-IDF 矩阵。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">Alias normalisation is followed by local Nomic keyword embeddings (a non-generative model) and cosine agglomerative clustering. Ambiguous terms such as Java/JavaScript and SQL are protected from merging. Each cluster gets a canonical term, yielding a 120-document × vocabulary TF-IDF matrix.</p>"
}

  "oldString": "<p>AE 结构为 <code>V → 512 → 256 → 64 → 256 → 512 → V</code>，使用 GELU、Dropout、AdamW 和 denoising reconstruction。除重构损失外，在 bottleneck 上加入 supervised contrastive / listwise retrieval loss：每个 JD 的 positive 是它的 hired CV，其余 109 份 CV 为 negatives。这样 AE 既学习文档表示，也直接从 10 组 GT 学习“匹配”。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">The AE is <code>V → 512 → 256 → 64 → 256 → 512 → V</code> with GELU, dropout, AdamW and denoising reconstruction.   "newString": "<p>AE 结构为 <code>V → 512 → 256 → 32 → 256 → 512 → V</code>，使用 GELU、Dropout、AdamW 和 denoising reconstruction。除重构损失外，在 bottleneck 上加入 supervised contrastive / listwise retrieval loss：每个 JD 的 positive 是它的 hired CV，其余 109 份 CV 为 negatives。这样 AE 既学习文档表示，也直接从 10 组 GT 学习“匹配”。bottleneck 做了 16/32/64 的消融，32 维最好。</p>\n<p class=\"en\">The AE is <code>V → 512 → 256 → 32 → 256 → 512 → V</code> with GELU, dropout, AdamW and denoising reconstruction. A supervised listwise retrieval loss is added on the bottleneck: the hired CV is the positive and the other 109 CVs are negatives.   "newString": "def ablation_table():\n    rows = []\n    for tag, dim in [(\"b16\", 16), (\"b32\", 32), (\"b64\", 64)]:\n        p = MET / f\"metrics_{tag}.json\"\n        if not p.exists():\n            continue\n        m = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")).get(\"ae_supervised_lopo\")\n        if not m:\n            continue\n        rows.append(\n            f\"<tr><td>{dim}</td><td>{m['recall@10']:.3f}</td>\"\n            f\"<td>{m['recall@5']:.3f}</td><td>{m['mrr@10']:.3f}</td>\"\n            f\"<td>{m['mean_rank']:.1f}</td></tr>\"\n        )\n    return (\n        \"<table class='data'><tr><th>Bottleneck dim</th><th>LOPO Recall@10</th>\"\n        \"<th>Recall@5</th><th>MRR@10</th><th>Mean rank</th></tr>\"\n        + \"\".join(rows)\n        + \"</table>\"\n    )\n\n\ndef error_table(err):"
}

  "oldString": "<h3>4.1 主要观察 / Main observations</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><b>关键词覆盖与排序：</b>命中案例中，hired CV 与 JD 的 must-have 关键词重合度高；未命中案例通常是 JD 的领域词/工具词在 positive CV 中缺失，或 top-1 候选共享了更通用的关键词。</li>\n<li><b>AE vs 基线：</b>AE 的优势在于压缩后的语义向量能缓解同义词/拼写差异；但如果关键词聚类把 must-have 与 nice-to-have 混在一起，AE 也会被通用词主导。</li>\n<li><b>LOPO vs in-sample：</b>in-sample 明显更高，说明 10 组 GT 的监督信号很容易被模型记住；LOPO 才是可信估计。</li>\n</ul>\n<p class=\"en\">Hits generally have strong must-have overlap between JD and hired CV; misses often reflect missing domain/tool terms or a top-1 candidate with more generic keywords. The gap between in-sample and LOPO shows that 10 pairs are easy to memorise; LOPO is the honest estimate.</p>",
  "newString": "<h3>4.1 Bottleneck 消融 / Bottleneck ablation</h3>\n{ablation_table()}\n<p class=\"small\">16 维欠拟合，64 维在 10 组 GT 上过拟合；32 维的 LOPO Recall@10 最好。 / 16-d underfits, 64-d overfits the 10 pairs; 32-d generalises best.</p>\n\n<h3>4.2 主要观察 / Main observations</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><b>AE 与基线打平 Recall，但 MRR 更低：</b>LOPO Recall@10 = 0.80，与 TF-IDF / BM25 的 0.80 相同；但 AE 的 MRR@10 只有 0.32（TF-IDF 0.44），说明它能把正确 CV 找进 Top-10，却经常把相似的干扰 CV 排在更前面。</li>\n<li><b>in-sample 严重乐观：</b>全部 10 组训练后同批评估为 1.00，而 LOPO 只有 0.80；10 组 GT 很容易被记住，报告必须以 LOPO 为准。</li>\n<li><b>两个 miss：</b>P04 排在 13（差一点），positive CV 缺少 Azure Synapse、PySpark 等 JD 关键词；P06 排在 36，JD 是 Deployment Strategist（项目/客户/交付），hired CV 是 Data Science 背景，两边关键词几乎零重合，属于抽取/标签口径问题。</li>\n<li><b>命中但排名靠后：</b>P02 第 9、P07 第 9、P09 第 10；positive CV 与 JD 的显式关键词重合少，AE 主要靠隐向量把它们拉进 Top-10，但 top-1 常被领域不相关的 CV 占据（如 P08 的 top-1 是视频剪辑 CV）。</li>\n<li><b>同义词仍是主要误差源：</b>flavour/flavor、key account management/client relationship management、B2B sales/international sales 等未完全合并，导致 P02/P07 的 positive 只共享 1 个 JD 关键词。</li>\n</ul>\n<p class=\"en\">The AE matches the baselines on Recall@10 (0.80) but has lower MRR (0.32 vs 0.44): it often retrieves the right CV but ranks a similar distractor above it. In-sample 1.00 vs LOPO 0.80 shows strong optimism from only 10 pairs. P04 is a near miss (rank 13) with missing Azure/PySpark terms; P06 (rank 36) has almost zero keyword overlap because the JD is a deployment/consulting role while the hired CV is data-science oriented. Synonym gaps (flavour/flavor, key account/client relationship, B2B/international sales) remain a major error source.</p>"
}

  • 10 份标准 JD + 10 份 hired CV：来自 JD + Hired CV examples，每份 PDF 前半是 JD，后半是 CV OF THE HIRED CANDIDATE
  • 100 份匿名 CV：来自 Anonymised-CVs-100
  • 候选池：110 份 CV
  • Excel 完全未使用
  • 关键词抽取：本地 LM Studio，Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct
  • 120 份文档，平均 24.5 个关键词/份（范围 12–46）
  • 关键词聚类：Nomic embedding + 层次聚类，1,552 个 canonical terms（来自 1,938 个归一化变体）
  • AE：V → 512 → 256 → 32 → 256 → 512 → V，32 维 bottleneck
  • 主评估：leave-one-pair-out（10 折）

主要结果

方法 Recall@10 Recall@5 MRR@10 平均排名
TF-IDF cosine 0.800 0.600 0.440 10.6
Keyword overlap 0.700 0.500 0.472 12.0
BM25 0.800 0.700 0.471 10.0
AE + supervised（in-sample） 1.000 1.000 1.000 1.0
AE + supervised（LOPO，主指标） 0.800 0.400 0.320 9.3

Bottleneck 消融（LOPO Recall@10）：16 → 0.200，32 → 0.800，64 → 0.600。

错误分析要点

  • LOPO 8/10 命中；P04 排 13、P06 排 36。
  • P04 是“差一点”：positive CV 缺 Azure Synapse、PySpark、Azure Data Engineer Associate 等 JD 关键词。
  • P06 是口径问题：JD 是 Deployment Strategist（项目/客户/交付），hired CV 是 Data Science 背景，关键词几乎零重合。
  • 其他命中但排名靠后：P02 第 9、P07 第 9、P09 第 10；AE 能把正确 CV 拉进 Top-10，但 top-1 常被领域不相关的 CV 占据。
  • 同义词未完全合并仍是主要误差源：flavour/flavor、key account management/client relationship management、B2B sales/international sales。
  • in-sample 1.00 vs LOPO 0.80：说明 10 组 GT 很容易被记住；报告以 LOPO 为准。

关键文件

  • 中英双语报告：HW4_6207/report/HW4_6207_Report_CN_EN.pdf（7 页，已打开预览）
  • 报告 HTML：HW4_6207/report/report_cn_en.html
  • 指标：HW4_6207/outputs/metrics/metrics.json
  • 每 query 结果：HW4_6207/outputs/retrieval/per_query.csv
  • 错误分析：HW4_6207/outputs/metrics/error_analysis.md
  • 关键词：HW4_6207/outputs/keywords/all_keywords.jsonl
  • 聚类/词表：HW4_6207/outputs/clusters/
  • AE 模型与向量：HW4_6207/outputs/models/
  • 复现说明：HW4_6207/README.md

运行 python src/train_eval.py --mode all --epochs 100 --bottleneck 32 可复现实验；随机种子固定为 42。

如果老师要求，我还可以继续加一版 AE + BM25 hybrid 实验，或者把报告改成学校模板/加组名。
